##### Your Stronger Bones For Life Guarantee

We guarantee that AlgaeCal's Bone Builder Pack will increase your bone mineral density or **your
money** back. The 16 bone-supporting nutrients start to work from the very first day you begin to
take them. And you're **guaranteed** to see measurable results on a DEXA scan after just six months.

This guarantee doesn't only cover you for the first six months. It covers you for life. That's
right. We promise that your bone density ** will continue to increase, with every DEXA scan showing
better results than the last…for your lifetime.**

And if any scan result fails to show progress, **we'll refund every penny you've paid for all
products purchased since your last scan.** Leaving you with no risk - either your bones get
stronger, or you get ALL your money back.

Learn More
[Your Stronger Bones For Life Guarantee]
[Skeptical? Good. So are we.]

##### Skeptical? Good. So are we.

If you've been let down by bold claims from supplement companies before, we understand. We have too.
That's why we do things differently.

We didn't just say our calcium supplement increases bone density. We backed it. With not one, not
two, **but three human clinical studies.** These independent studies were published in peer-reviewed
scientific journals. And the results have been confirmed by **thousands of DEXA scans in medical
clinics across all 50 states.**

** So if you're skeptical, we welcome it. ** Read the studies. Check the ingredients. Head to
YouTube and search “AlgaeCal reviews.” Because when something actually works, it doesn't mind being
held to a higher standard.

The numbers don't lie.

And the results speak for themselves.

[Clinically Supported]

##### Clinically Supported

AlgaeCal has been studied in ** three human clinical trials** conducted by researchers from leading
institutions including ** Harvard Medical School, Georgetown University, and the University of
Texas.** The conclusion was the same across all three:

**AlgaeCal is the only calcium supplement ever shown to increase bone density^{‡}.**

[Most Natural Calcium Supplements are Made From Rocks]

Plant-Based Calcium

##### Most Natural Calcium Supplements are Made From Rocks

** AlgaeCal is different. It's made from organic marine algae ** — mesophyllum superpositum - a
plant-based source that naturally contains ** all the bone-supporting minerals your body ** needs to
stop bone loss and increase bone density.

Stronger Bones For Life Guarantee

###### Stronger Bones For Life Guarantee

[StrongerBonesForLife]

Your Stronger Bones For Life Guarantee. You need strong bones for the rest of your life to enjoy
rather than endure your golden years. With our guarantee, you can continue enjoying your favorite
activities for the rest of your days.

Measurable improvements will appear at 6 months from when you start your AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium
Boost program. So if your next DEXA scan is scheduled half a year or more from now, we guarantee you
will see a bone density increase.

You may choose to wait for your next scheduled scan so that it is paid for by your insurance, or you
may choose to pay out of pocket to check your results earlier. Either way is fine.

Just allow at least ** 6 consecutive ** months of taking the products as directed before your
follow-up scan. We encourage you to take a scan every year to make sure you're still building new
bone.

**IMPORTANT:**Ensure you get your DEXA scan at the same clinic every time. Ideally, you'd get your
scan on the same machine, too. That way, every scan is directly comparable to the last. If any DEXA
does not show an improvement in either hip or spine bone density you will be refunded for all
bottles of AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost purchased since your previous scan.

In other words, “scan to scan to scan” improvements MUST be yours for the rest of your life. Now
it's only a matter of making a decision. We hope you choose to join the thousands who have opted to
Break Free.

If you have any questions, please contact us at [1-800-820-0184][57] or email us at
[support@algaecal.com][58]

** Your 3 Steps to Guaranteed Bone Density: **

1.

Have a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old to establish a baseline measurement. (If you had
a DEXA scan more than 30 days ago, your guaranteed period will launch from your next scan onward. So
don't wait! Get started building healthy new bone right now before your guarantee begins.)

2.

Take AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at full dose as directed for at least six months.

3.

Get your follow up DEXA scan from the same clinic as your first scan. It doesn't matter when… six,
twelve, even 24 months after you start - as long as you have continued to use your products between
scans.

If your follow up scan does not show an increase in your hip or spinal bone density, we refund every
penny you paid us between those two scans.

We guarantee that AlgaeCal's Bone Builder Pack will increase your bone mineral density or **your
money** back. The 16 bone-supporting nutrients start to work from the very first day you begin to
take them. And you're **guaranteed** to see measurable results on a DEXA scan after just six months.

This guarantee doesn't only cover you for the first six months. It covers you for life. That's
right. We promise that your bone density ** will continue to increase, with every DEXA scan showing
better results than the last…for your lifetime.**

And if any scan result fails to show progress, **we'll refund every penny you've paid for all
products purchased since your last scan.** Leaving you with no risk - either your bones get
stronger, or you get ALL your money back.

[Skeptical? Good. So are we.]

##### Skeptical? Good. So are we.

If you've been let down by bold claims from supplement companies before, we understand. We have too.
That's why we do things differently.

We didn't just say our calcium supplement increases bone density. We backed it. With not one, not
two, **but three human clinical studies.** These independent studies were published in peer-reviewed
scientific journals. And the results have been confirmed by **thousands of DEXA scans in medical
clinics across all 50 states.**

** So if you're skeptical, we welcome it. ** Read the studies. Check the ingredients. Head to
YouTube and search “AlgaeCal reviews.” Because when something actually works, it doesn't mind being
held to a higher standard.

The numbers don't lie.

And the results speak for themselves.

AlgaeCal has been studied in ** three human clinical trials** conducted by researchers from leading
institutions including ** Harvard Medical School, Georgetown University, and the University of
Texas.** The conclusion was the same across all three:

**AlgaeCal is the only calcium supplement ever shown to increase bone density^{‡}.**

plant-based source that naturally contains ** all the bone-supporting minerals your body ** needs to
stop bone loss and increase bone density.

## Our promise to you

### 30-day money back guarantee

HugeDomains provides a 100% satisfaction guarantee on every domain name that we sell through our
website. If you buy a domain and are unhappy with it, we will accept the return within 30 days and
issue a full refund – no questions asked.

### Quick delivery of the domain

In most cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however
access to domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

### Safe and secure shopping

Your online safety and security is our top priority. We understand the importance of protecting your
personal information.

We protect your information through SSL encryption technology, providing the safest, most secure
shopping experience possible. Additionally, you may checkout with PayPal or Escrow.com.

## FAQs

[See more FAQs][23]
[How do I transfer to another registrar such as GoDaddy?][24]

Yes, you can transfer your domain to any registrar or hosting company once you have purchased it.
Since domain transfers are a manual process, it can take up to 5 days to transfer the domain.

 

Domains purchased with payment plans are not eligible to transfer until all payments have been made.
Please remember that our 30-day money back guarantee is void once a domain has been transferred.

 

For transfer instructions to GoDaddy, please [click here][25].

[How do I get the domain after the purchase?][26]

Once you purchase the domain we will push it into an account for you at our registrar,
NameBright.com, we will then send you an email with your NameBright username and password. In most
cases access to the domain will be available within one to two hours of purchase, however access to
domains purchased after business hours will be available within the next business day.

[What comes with the domain name?][27]

Nothing else is included with the purchase of the domain name. Our registrar NameBright.com does
offer email packages for a yearly fee, however you will need to find hosting and web design services
on your own.

[Do you offer payment plans?][28]

Yes we offer payment plans for up to 12 months. [See details][29].

[How do I keep my personal information private?][30]

If you wish the domain ownership information to be private, add WhoIs Privacy Protection to your
domain. This hides your personal information from the general public.

 

To add privacy protection to your domain, do so within your registrar account. NameBright offers
WhoIs Privacy Protection for free for the first year, and then for a small fee for subsequent years.

 

Whois information is not updated immediately. It typically takes several hours for Whois data to
update, and different registrars are faster than others. Usually your Whois information will be
fully updated within two days.

# Innovative marine biotechnologies

Marinova is an Australian biotechnology company dedicated to the development and production of high
purity seaweed extracts for the betterment of human health. We specialise in the research,
development and manufacture of [fucoidan ][41]compounds – highly bioactive polysaccharides derived
from select species of brown seaweed.­

As the global leader in fucoidan science, Marinova is the supplier of choice to world-renowned
research institutions. Our reputation is built on the unrivalled quality and efficacy of our
bioactive fucoidan extracts and two decades of rigorous scientific investigation. 

Marinova’s global research and development program welcomes [collaborators][42] that share our
mindset for scientific innovation. Our highly characterised fucoidan fractions are well-suited to
medical device applications and pharmaceutical research.

Marinova is also home to the unique range of [Maritech^{®} organic fucoidan ][43]extracts - high
purity fucoidans developed specifically for nutritional, cosmetic and animal health applications.

**Marinova: Pure Source, Pure Science.**

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],
[Inhaler][72], [Lotion][73], [Gel][74], [Suspension / syrup][75], [Nasal Drops/Sprays][76], etc.  

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

## **These are Some of the Key Features of Our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Plant:**
* The continuous and uninterrupted flow of Process & Facilities that comply with Schedule “M”
  Specifications & **WHO-GMP **norms.
* Effective sanitation and fully automated HVAC System.
* Facility to manufacture every variety of tablets including un-coated, film-coated, double-layered,
  sugar-coated, enteric coated and slow release tablets.
* VAHP chillers that are 100% environment friendly.
* Duo Pass Reverse Osmosis water system/ de-mineralization plant.
* Multi-Stage Distillation plant.
* De-Humidification unit and dust extraction systems and separate AHUs for each zone.
* Zone-wise segregation of every critical processing activity, to prevent cross-contamination
* Even uniforms are marked with zone-specific colors to ensure complete segregation.
* Isolated and dedicated facilities for producing B-Lactam and Cephalosporin dosage forms.
* Area-specific Air Environment Conditioning with respect to temperature, pressure, humidity,
  filtration, etc.
* Zero-discharge Effluent Treatment Plant.
* Alternative power generation system to ensure uninterrupted production and Separate air handling
  units for each production department.
* In house R&D facility with experienced and talented researchers.

All the above-mentioned facilities are **[WHO, GMP certified and ISO 9001][79]** accredited for
systems. Regular global audits are conducted to further uplift our standards.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

[

### Drug Development

][113]

We provide customised **CDMO services **designed to meet the diverse needs of the industry. From
out-licensing and supply to one-off analysis, custom developments, and advanced formulation
services.

[⟶][114]
[

### Commercial Manufacturing

][115]

Our **CDMO manufacturing network** includes four state-of-the-art facilities in Europe and one in
Japan, each staffed with a dedicated team committed to delivering unparalleled quality in every
offering and solution we provide.

[⟶][116]
[

### Clinical Manufacturing

][117]

We guide your project through every phase of clinical manufacturing, from feasibility studies and
pre-clinical material preparation to **GMP-compliant production**. Our end-to-end approach ensures
seamless transitions between phases, delivering high-quality solutions tailored to your clinical
needs. 

[⟶][118]
[

### Our CDMO Services

][119]

We offer fully integrated **CDMO services **covering the entire process: from initial planning and
supply chain management to regulatory affairs, for your drug product.

[⟶][120]

## Our Network

Our global presence as a CDMO spans across seven locations around the world, simplifying
coordination and communication, saving valuable time. This strategic approach allows our clients to
focus on their core competencies.

[[flag][flag]

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

⟶][127]

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

Journey

## A story of helping fight diseases better

[See our entire journey][139]
1907
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey beginning in 1907]

Started manufacturing tinctures and alcohol at Vadodara

1940
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1940]

Began production of cough syrups, vitamins, tonics and sulphur drugs

1961
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1961]

Inaugurated Penicilin plant with Lal Bahadur Shastri in attendance

1967
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1967]

Initiated bulk manufacturing of Vitamin B12

1971
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1971]

Manufactured Erythromycin for the first time in Indian history

1972
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1972]

Launched Althrocin, a brand of Erythromycin

1997
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1997]

Althrocin moves to become top selling brand in India

1999
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 1999]

Kickstarted the production of synthetic, organic API

2000
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2000]

Received ISO 14000 certification for facilities at Vadodara

2001
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2001]

Began production of Cephalosporin C

2007
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2007]

Acquired non-oncology business of M/s Dabur Pharma Ltd.

2009
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2009]

Addressed chronic therapies through multiple marketing divisions

2011
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2011]

Demerged from Alembic group to form Alembic Pharmaceutical Ltd, and gets listed

2012
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2012]

Unveiled the Dematology division in domestic market with 8 products

2013
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2013]

Started first NDA with a partner and commenced filing in EU, Australia and Brazil

2015
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2015]

Launched Aripiprazole and established the US Front-end as also transitioning to in-house marketing
in the US

2016
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2016]

Struck a JV with Orbicular – Aleor Dermaceutical Limited to develop dermatology products for the
international market

2017

[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Inaugurated the manufacturing facility for Oncology medicines, including oral solids and liquid
injectable vials, in the presence of the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Gujarat, Shri. Vijay Rupani

2017
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2017]

Acquired Orit Laboratories LLC, USA

2018
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2018]

Received FDA approvals for Aleor’s dermatology facility

2019
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2019]

Granted approvals for Oncology oral solid facility

Entered a JV to foray into the China market

2020
[Alembic Pharmaceuticals corporate journey milestone in 2020]

Achieved the milestone of US$ 250 million sales in the US frontend

#### A Day in the Life of A Molecule

Press play to meet Mike the Molecule—he’s got big dreams and a big journey ahead! Follow along as he
takes on every stage of drug development here at Altasciences.Science has never been this fun!

[Learn more! ][18]

[A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology]

#### A Day in the Life of a Veterinary Scientist, Ophthalmology

Marianna Bacellar-Galdino has always loved scientific research, and after a particularly eye-opening
project in veterinary school, ophthalmology became the thread connecting all her scientific
interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

We are a forward-thinking, mid-size early phase contract research organization, in Canada and the
U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.
* [ [Preclinical Services] ][20]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Preclinical Services ][21]
  
  Safety assessments for both small and large molecules
* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

interests—and eventually her whole career.

[Watch now! ][19]

U.S., offering biopharmaceutical companies of all sizes a proven, flexible approach to early drug
development, including preclinical safety testing, clinical pharmacology (Phase I to Phase II),
bioanalysis (preclinical to Phase IV), research services, and manufacturing and analytical services.

Focused on your success … always available and always looking ahead ... moving in unison to deliver
big impact with a personal touch.

## WHAT WE DO

We help you reach early phase drug development decision-making milestones sooner, improving speed
and ease from lead candidate selection to proof of concept, and beyond.

* [ [Clinical Services] ][22]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Clinical Services ][23]
  
  Clinical pharmacology trials from first-in-human to end of Phase II
* [ [Manufacturing and Analytical Services] ][24]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Manufacturing and Analytical Services ][25]
  
  From formulation development, Phase I through commercial manufacturing, and ICH stability testing
* [ [thumb] ][26]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Bioanalysis Services ][27]
  
  Package or stand-alone. Preclinical, Phase I to Phase IV bioanalytical laboratories
* [ [research support services] ][28]
  
  #### [ **ALTA**SCIENCES Research Support Services ][29]
  
  Comprehensive CRO services to support clinical and preclinical studies

## Technology Bridging Tradition and Innovation

How interface technology from Pepperl+Fuchs has been setting standards for almost 70 years and why
it is not losing any of its relevance in the age of digitalization.

[Go to Article][7]

## Main Topics
* [ [The E4SHUTTLE from Eurofork] ][8]
  
  #### Pallets Precisely Positioned
  
  In automated pallet shuttle warehouses, the position of machines must be tracked in real time.
  Eurofork relies on a powerful positioning system from Pepperl+Fuchs to make this possible.
  
  [Read more][9]
* [ [AI-generated biorefinery in futuristic style, with a dispenser dropping fuel made of
  agricultural residues] ][10]
  
  #### Second-Generation Ethanol—a Milestone in Brazil’s Energy Transition
  
  Brazil is focusing on second-generation ethanol to diversify its biofuel mix. As a technical
  partner, Pepperl+Fuchs supports the construction of new bioethanol plants.
  
  [Read more][11]
* [ [Dr. Wilhelm Nehring, CEO, and Martin Walter, CFO of the Pepperl+Fuchs Group] ][12]
  
  #### Honoring Tradition. Enabling New Beginnings.
  
  Interview with Dr. Wilhelm Nehring, CEO, and Martin Walter, CFO.
  
  [Read more][13]

[

##### View all articles

###### Filter articles according to your interests

][14]

### Alessandro Garola

Chief Technology Officer at Eurofork

The partnership with Pepperl+Fuchs enables us to be among the most competitive companies on the
market in economic and, above all, technological terms.

[Go to article][15]

### Claus Blödorn

Development Project Management at KNAPP AG

During the intense development phase, useful optimizations, even beyond the original specifications,
could be implemented quickly and easily. This close and trust-based relationship was ultimately the
key to success.here.

[Go to article][16]

### Philipp Jordan

company owner of eralytics

The solution from Pepperl+Fuchs allows the replacement to be carried out within a few minutes,
without long downtimes or time-consuming staff training.

[Go to article][17]

### Muthu Siva

Head of SEC Chennai, Pepperl+Fuchs

We don’t just sell products. We deliver purpose-built solutions that are engineered around our
customers’ exact needs.

[Go to article][18]

### Søren Gothil Hansen

Manager of Mechanical, Civil & Inspection (MCI) at Kalundborg Refinery

In order to meet the requirements of the next stage of digitalization, the hardware should be
brought up to the latest technical standards and have future-oriented 5G technology.

[Go to article][19]

### Nils Schwäbe

Product Line Manager at Swan Analytical Instruments

Exceeding the limit values can lead to a drastic drop in the performance of the electrolyzer after a
very short time. We are talking about a period of minutes or hours.

[Go to article][20]

### Lutz Liebers

Chief Operating Officer Process Automation at Pepperl+Fuchs

With Ethernet-APL, users can finally make full use of the wealth of information that modern field
devices and sensors record and make available. This changes everything for process plant operators!

[Go to Article][21]

### Andreas Redekop

Project Manager at Vision Machine Technic Bildverarbeitungssysteme GmbH
With its open architecture and modular approach, our software is simply unbeatable when it comes to
adaptability.

[Go to Article][22]

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and
## commercialising medicines that transform the lives of patients & their families around the world.

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

[READ MORE][89]

### [Amryt Compliance][90]
### [Aegerion Consent Decree][91]

## Advocacy

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

[READ MORE][92]

## Join us

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody
our values and wake up every day with the goal of changing lives of people with rare and
debilitating diseases.

[GET IN TOUCH][93]

## Follow us and keep up to date

biotechnology across Australasia. We connect scientists, industry, policy makers, and innovators to
advance the sustainable use of marine resources for the benefit of people, the planet, and the blue
economy.

Our mission is to foster collaboration, innovation, and education in marine biotechnology, from
fundamental research to real-world applications. We help to foster partnerships with academia,
industry, Indigenous communities, and international networks to promote responsible and impactful
marine biotechnology across the region.

[Marine Biotechnology][27]

**Marine Biotechnology** welcomes high-quality research papers presenting novel data on the
biotechnology of aquatic organisms. The journal publishes high quality papers in the areas of
molecular biology, genomics, proteomics, cell biology, and biochemistry, and particularly encourages
submissions of papers related to genome biology such as linkage mapping, large-scale gene
discoveries, QTL analysis, physical mapping, and comparative and functional genome analysis. Papers
on technological development and marine natural products should demonstrate innovation and novel
applications.

[
[Journal of Marine Science and Engineering (JMSE; ISSN 2077-1312) is an international, peer-reviewed
open access journal which provides an advanced forum for studies related to marine science and
engineering. Current IF is 2.033 according to the Jour…]
][28]

**Journal of Marine Science and Engineering **(JMSE; ISSN 2077-1312) is an
international, peer-reviewed open access journal which provides an
advanced forum for studies related to marine science and engineering.
Current IF is 2.9 according to the Journal Citation Reports (Web of
Science). Q1 ranking in "Engineering,
Marine," we also rank Q2 (19/63) in the "Oceanography" category and
(6/16) in the "Engineering, Ocean" category. Marine Biology is one of its essential sections. Prof.
Dr. Magnus
Wahlberg is the section Editor-in-Chief. We maintain a rapid, yet
rigorous, peer-review, manuscript handling and editorial process. The
median publication time is 34 days.

[
[Marine Drugs (ISSN 1660-3397; CODEN: MDARE6) is the leading peer-reviewed open access journal on
the research, development, and production of biologically and therapeutically active compounds from
the sea. Marine Drugs is published monthly online by…]
][29]

**Marine Drugs **(ISSN 1660-3397; CODEN: MDARE6) is the leading peer-reviewed open access journal on
the research, development, and production of biologically and therapeutically active compounds from
the sea. Marine Drugs is published monthly online by MDPI. The journal is covered by leading
indexing services, including PubMed, Web of Science Science Citation Index Expanded (current Impact
Factor 5.4), and Scopus (2022 CiteScore 9.6).  In 2020, authors received a first decision 12 days
after submission while the total publication time was an average of 33 days.

guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

formulation products at an affordable price.

We are present across 150+ global markets including the US, Europe and Growth Markets, and are
ranked amongst the top 10*** generic companies across eight countries in Europe.

Steadfast in our commitment to innovation & research, we invest significantly in our R&D. 830
filings for ANDAs in the US, with 600+ approvals for the same.

### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.

Dr. Mark Goldsmith of Revolution Medicines describes the benefit seen by advanced patients who
received the pancreatic cancer pill daraxonrasib vs those in a control group of investigator's
choice standard-of-care chemotherapy, and he discusses the medicine's side effect profile. Plus,
next steps for this treatment in pancreatic cancer and beyond.

in the phase 3 portion. Bicara hopes to use the study to eventually gain an accelerated approval.

### ASCO 2026: Fresh off an IPO, Eikon Therapeutics Chairman & CEO Roger Perlmutter describes the
### scientific idea behind the company, and walks us through the leading programs | 05/31/26

The lead two programs, which target TLR7/8 and PARP1, have data at ASCO and were licensed with the
idea of laying the foundation for clinical expertise at Eikon. Another clinical program, a WRN
helicase inhibitor, is the first to entirely come out of Eikon's platform. Plus, Dr. Perlmutter's
take on being a public company, and his thoughts on China as a medicine cabinet to the world.

### data release for the PD-1xVEGF bi-specific antibody Ivonescimab | 06/01/26

Ivonescimab plus chemo reduced the risk of death by 34% vs the PD-1 Tislelizumab plus chemo, and
they are given the opportunity to respond to some of the pushback heard around McCormick Place.

combo was 11.1 months versus 5.6 months, compared to alpelisib plus fulvestrant.

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance.

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

# World-class science. Life-changing impact.

Get an inside look at the work we do every day to define what's possible and transform patients'
lives through science.

[ see what drives us ][68]

## Life + Science

[ view more stories ][69]

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

[ View more ][75]

## Pipeline

AS OF APRIL 30, 2026
* 50 Compounds in development
* 40+ Disease areas being studied

Our pipeline targets areas where we can deliver transformative medicines — for patients who need
them most.

# Caltron Clays & Chemicals

Caltron Clays & Chemicals Pvt Ltd is No.1 Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Raw Material manufacturers and
suppliers in India. Caltron Clays is an ISO 9001 Certified & CRISIL rated company, the only of its
kind in the minerals industry. Caltron Clays is a recognized export house specializing in the
processing and export of mineral, oxide, and chemicals.

[View Our Products][10]

## About Caltron

CALTRON is proudly celebrating its 26th year of successful operations having established a strong
reputation as a world-class manufacturer of natural calcium sources. Over the years, the company has
earned the trust of global customers through its unwavering commitment to quality innovation and
excellence.

Caltron proudly holds an extensive range of internationally recognized certifications including ISO
9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 18001, HACCP, HALAL, KOSHER, VEGAN, ECOCERT ORGANIC, SMETA 4 Pillar,
WHO-GMP compliance and DUNS registration. These certifications reflect the company’s dedication to
maintaining the highest standards across quality safety sustainability and ethical business
practices.

### CARBOGEN AMCIS Commissions Ground-Mounted Pho-tovoltaic Plant at Its Hunzenschwil Site

CARBOGEN AMCIS, a Switzerland-based pharmaceutical process development and Active Pharmaceutical
Ingredient (API) manufacturing company, has suc-cessfully commissioned a new ground-mounted
photovoltaic system at its Hunzenschwil site in Switzerland. With this project, the company
underscores its long-term commitment to sustainability and the expansion of renewable energy.
[Read more][289]

identified following an on-site unannounced inspection.

* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

[Explore our history][42]

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

* SINCE 1885

Impeccable distribution of high-quality ingredients to the feed, food, pharma and technical
industries worldwide since 1885.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical
industries.

### TECHNICAL INDUSTRIES

## A WORD IS A WORD.

### NO MATTER THE LANGUAGE.

Partnerships are crucial to us. And many of them have existed for generations.
* ### 140 years and we're just getting started
  
  2025 marked our 140^{th }anniversary. That’s worth celebrating. We’ve grown from a small grocery
  and goods store to a global firm with about 200 employees and 5^{th} generation family ownership.
  But the journey has only just started, as we will continue growing our family-run company – just
  as each generation has done before.
  [altText]

## RELIABLE

### SINCE 1885

We are not the same company today as we were when Mads Chr. Olesen founded his small grocery and
goods store back in 1885. But one thing is unchanged – being reliable in everything we do

[Explore our history][42]

### ALWAYS ON TIME.

#### Regardless of TIME ZONE.

Being on time. Every time. This is still as important to the 5^{th} generation as it was to the
founder.

[Φωτογραφία από Who we are]
Who we are

At Compass Marine Medical, we are proud to be a leading provider of specialized healthcare solutions
for the maritime industry. Established with the mission to enhance the health and safety of
seafarers worldwide, our company is built on a foundation of expertise, reliability, and innovation.

Our team comprises highly skilled medical professionals, qualified pharmacists, healthcare
practitioners, logistics specialists, and account managers, all dedicated to addressing the unique
medical needs of those at sea. With extensive experience in maritime medicine, we have earned a
reputation as a trusted partner for shipping companies, cruise lines, and offshore operations.
Compass Marine Medical proudly maintains membership with IMPA, ISSA and NVVS, reflecting our
commitment to upholding the highest standards within the maritime industry.

[See more][30]

## Fast and Reliable Medical Solutions in challenging environments

Our extensive experience and deep understanding of the industry allow us to operate effectively in
some of the world’s most challenging environments, providing round-the-clock medical supplies &
ensuring the health and safety of maritime crew members is never compromised.

 

 

[Φωτογραφία από Logistics]

### Logistics

At Compass, we take full responsibility for managing all logistics processes, ensuring that your
medical supplies are delivered reliably and on time. Our team meticulously coordinates each step,
providing you with peace of mind you’re your products are handled safely and efficiently throughout
the supply chain.

[Φωτογραφία από Global Network]

### Global Network

Compass Marine Medical boasts a widespread international reach, capable of delivering medical
supplies to a vast number of countries and ports worldwide. Supported by our extensive
pharmaceutical network, we ensure swift and reliable delivery, no matter the destination.

[Φωτογραφία από Regulatory expertise]

### Regulatory expertise

At Compass, we possess in-depth knowledge of the regulatory requirements associated with various
flag states. Our team ensures full compliance with the standards of each flag scale, meeting all
legal and safety obligations along with ensuring peace of mind for our clients.

[Φωτογραφία από Comprehensive Solutions]

### Comprehensive Solutions

At Compass, we deliver comprehensive maritime healthcare solutions, including vessel inventory
management system, new building projects, medical disposal, global distribution, telemedical
services, and mental health support, all focused on streamlining operations and ensuring the health,
safety, and wellbeing of your crew.

[Φωτογραφία από Accreditations]

### Accreditations

Compass Marine Medical complies with WHO, FDA, MHRA, DHA, DMA, MSN, and Maritime Health Authorities.
ISO 9001:2015 certification underscores our commitment to top-quality management across all services
and operations.

## Our Expertise

At Compass Marine Medical, we specialize in providing high-quality medical products that comply with
Good Distribution Practice (GDP) regulations. We tailor our supply solutions to meet the specific
demands of various sectors, including Commercial Shipping, Cruise, Yachting, and the Oil & Gas
Industry. Our expertise ensures that every product delivered upholds the highest standards of
safety, efficacy, and regulatory
compliance, supporting the unique needs of each business segment with precision and reliability.

 

[
[Φωτογραφία από Commercial Shipping]

## Commercial Shipping

Compass Marine Medical is the ideal partner and supplier for commercial vessels, providing reliable,
around-the-clock support to ensure seamless healthcare management. Through our comprehensive
inventory management solution, CMS, and our Vessel Inventory Management System (VIMS) platform, we
guarantee compliance and timely delivery of medical supplies, no matter where your vessel is
located. Our dedicated services are designed to keep your crew protected and your operations running
smoothly, 24/7.

[Φωτογραφία από Who we are]
Who we are

At Compass Marine Medical, we are proud to be a leading provider of specialized healthcare solutions
for the maritime industry. Established with the mission to enhance the health and safety of
seafarers worldwide, our company is built on a foundation of expertise, reliability, and innovation.

Our team comprises highly skilled medical professionals, qualified pharmacists, healthcare
practitioners, logistics specialists, and account managers, all dedicated to addressing the unique
medical needs of those at sea. With extensive experience in maritime medicine, we have earned a
reputation as a trusted partner for shipping companies, cruise lines, and offshore operations.
Compass Marine Medical proudly maintains membership with IMPA, ISSA and NVVS, reflecting our
commitment to upholding the highest standards within the maritime industry.

[See more][30]

## Fast and Reliable Medical Solutions in challenging environments

Our extensive experience and deep understanding of the industry allow us to operate effectively in
some of the world’s most challenging environments, providing round-the-clock medical supplies &
ensuring the health and safety of maritime crew members is never compromised.

 

 

[Φωτογραφία από Logistics]

### Logistics

At Compass, we take full responsibility for managing all logistics processes, ensuring that your
medical supplies are delivered reliably and on time. Our team meticulously coordinates each step,
providing you with peace of mind you’re your products are handled safely and efficiently throughout
the supply chain.

[Φωτογραφία από Global Network]

### Global Network

Compass Marine Medical boasts a widespread international reach, capable of delivering medical
supplies to a vast number of countries and ports worldwide. Supported by our extensive
pharmaceutical network, we ensure swift and reliable delivery, no matter the destination.

[Φωτογραφία από Regulatory expertise]

### Regulatory expertise

At Compass, we possess in-depth knowledge of the regulatory requirements associated with various
flag states. Our team ensures full compliance with the standards of each flag scale, meeting all
legal and safety obligations along with ensuring peace of mind for our clients.

[Φωτογραφία από Comprehensive Solutions]

### Comprehensive Solutions

At Compass, we deliver comprehensive maritime healthcare solutions, including vessel inventory
management system, new building projects, medical disposal, global distribution, telemedical
services, and mental health support, all focused on streamlining operations and ensuring the health,
safety, and wellbeing of your crew.

[Φωτογραφία από Accreditations]

### Accreditations

Compass Marine Medical complies with WHO, FDA, MHRA, DHA, DMA, MSN, and Maritime Health Authorities.
ISO 9001:2015 certification underscores our commitment to top-quality management across all services
and operations.

## Our Expertise

At Compass Marine Medical, we specialize in providing high-quality medical products that comply with
Good Distribution Practice (GDP) regulations. We tailor our supply solutions to meet the specific
demands of various sectors, including Commercial Shipping, Cruise, Yachting, and the Oil & Gas
Industry. Our expertise ensures that every product delivered upholds the highest standards of
safety, efficacy, and regulatory
compliance, supporting the unique needs of each business segment with precision and reliability.

 

[
[Φωτογραφία από Commercial Shipping]

## Commercial Shipping

Compass Marine Medical is the ideal partner and supplier for commercial vessels, providing reliable,
around-the-clock support to ensure seamless healthcare management. Through our comprehensive
inventory management solution, CMS, and our Vessel Inventory Management System (VIMS) platform, we
guarantee compliance and timely delivery of medical supplies, no matter where your vessel is
located. Our dedicated services are designed to keep your crew protected and your operations running
smoothly, 24/7.

[Φωτογραφία από Cruise]

## Cruise

Compass Marine Medical is the optimal partner and supplier for cruise ships, delivering high-quality
pharmaceutical products tailored to the unique needs of the industry. Our efficient and reliable
logistics solutions ensure that your vessel is always stocked with essential medical supplies,
maintaining safety and compliance at all times. Trust us to support your operations with seamless
service and guaranteed product quality, every voyage.

][32]
[
[Φωτογραφία από Yachting]

## Yachting

Compass Marine Medical is the ideal partner and supplier for yachts, delivering tailored healthcare
solutions that meet the specific needs of each yacht. Our personalized approach ensures that every
requirement is addressed with precision, while our efficient and reliable logistics guarantee timely
delivery of medical supplies and pharmaceuticals. Trust us to support your yacht with seamless
service and high-quality products, ensuring safety and peace of mind at sea.

][33]
[
[Φωτογραφία από Oil & Gas Industry]

## Oil & Gas Industry

Compass Marine Medical is the ideal partner and supplier for the oil and gas industry, delivering
top-quality pharmaceutical products tailored to the demanding offshore environment. Our efficient
and reliable logistics solutions ensure timely delivery and consistent supply, supporting safety and
operational efficiency on your rigs and platforms. Trust us to be a dependable partner in meeting
the complex healthcare needs of your offshore operations.

][34]

Compass Marine Medical is your premier global supplier for oxygen solutions, offering reliable and
efficient delivery worldwide. Our extensive logistics network ensures timely and secure supply,
meeting the critical needs of vessels, offshore platforms, and medical facilities across the globe.
Trust us to provide consistent, high-quality oxygen solutions that support safety and health in even
the most remote locations.

Compass Marine Medical is the ideal partner offering advanced telemedical and mental health
solutions tailored to the maritime industry. Our reliable telehealth platform ensures crew members
have immediate access to medical and psychological support, regardless of location. With our
expertise and commitment to comprehensive care, we help enhance crew well-being, safety, and
operational efficiency on board and ashore.

#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

[Read More >][73]

#### **Crowley Mariners Honored with Gallant Ship Award on National Maritime Day**

Crowley mariners who served aboard the U.S.-flagged tanker Stena Immaculate were honored with the
U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime
industry’s highest distinctions, recognizes the 23-member crew’s extraordinary professionalism,
courage and commitment to safety.

[Read the Full press Release>][72]

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

[Read More >][73]

millions of global data points, including patent and non-patent literature. Discovery provides users
with a 360-degree view of the competitive and technology landscape in an instant!

### Business Development Professionals

collaborate with.

Stop waiting for analyst reports. Access primary source data — updated continuously — across every

Why Teams Switch

## Good instincts are nice.
## *Great data* are better.

People switch to DrugPatentWatch because they're tired of the high cost and low quality of their
analysts. You shouldn't have to wait for a report to understand your market.

Every drug is perpetually updatd from primary sources. The latest information is always available —
no delays, no filters, no spin.

[See why others have switched →][6]
Patent Expiry Opportunities — 2025–2030

Keytruda (pembrolizumab) 2028 High Value
Humira (adalimumab) Expired Generic
Eliquis (apixaban) 2026 Watch
Ozempic (semaglutide) 2032 Monitored
The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

[See the raw data →][7]
📥
Export everything, keep it forever
Download full datasets in clean, structured formats. Your exports belong to you — not to a
subscription you might cancel.
🔄
Updated while you sleep
Every drug profile is refreshed from primary sources daily. No editorial lag. No publication

experiences responsive communication, consistent supply, and measurable value from our

Drugzone combines industry expertise with strong logistics to provide comprehensive generic
distribution services. Each capability is designed to help healthcare and specialty partners
maintain a safe, seamless, and cost-effective supply chain.

Reliable, nationwide generic pharmaceutical supply for healthcare and specialty care providers
across the U.S. Our consistent processes make us a trusted choice among wholesale pharmaceutical
distributors in the U.S.

State-of-the-art warehouses and a nationwide delivery network ensure secure storage and timely
shipments, reducing inventory gaps for healthcare networks nationwide.

checks to ensure healthcare providers—across human and animal health—receive authentic and traceable
products.

Drugzone strengthens its nationwide supply reliability through long-standing partnerships with
leading generic manufacturers. These strategic alliances ensure verified authenticity, stable
pricing, and consistent access to essential medications across multiple therapeutic areas.

traceability.

Every product undergoes multi-step verification and documentation to confirm authenticity before
distribution.

reliable access to quality pharmaceuticals across the U.S. under NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025
standards.

Drugzone supports healthcare facilities nationwide with access to safe, cost-effective generic
formulations. Each product is stored and distributed following the strictest compliance standards.

[img]

networks, and specialty care facilities.

[img]

Reliable distribution designed to help hospitals and specialty networks maintain consistent

[img]

Strict adherence to NABP and FDA guidelines, ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable delivery of
human health products.

providers, ensuring consistent access to essential products.

[img]

Dedicated pharmaceutical solutions designed for veterinarians, clinics, and animal healthcare
facilities.

[img]

Sutures, oncology formulations, and generic alternatives tailored for animal health practices.

[img]

### Trusted Distribution

Compliant with all state and federal regulations to guarantee authentic, traceable supply for animal
care providers.

[Know more][21]
[img]

## Mission & Vision

[img]

### Mission

To advance healthcare delivery by ensuring access to safe, effective, and affordable generic
pharmaceuticals through innovation, compliance, and service excellence. Drugzone is committed to
empowering healthcare providers—hospitals, long-term care facilities, specialty clinics, and
veterinary networks—through transparent operations, ethical sourcing, and nationwide reliability.
* **Our mission focuses on:**
* Ensuring secure, compliant, and traceable pharmaceutical distribution across all 50 states.
* Maintaining ethical and transparent partnerships with healthcare providers and manufacturers.
* Promoting innovation in logistics, compliance, and digital fulfillment for greater efficiency.
* Upholding regulatory integrity through NABP, FDA, and DSCSA 2025 compliance.
* Creating long-term value by prioritizing patient safety and partner trust.

[img]

### Vision

To be among the nation’s most trusted pharmaceutical distribution companies, defined by integrity,
professionalism, and continuous innovation. Drugzone envisions a future where compliant and
affordable access to quality pharmaceuticals strengthens the entire continuum of care.
* **Our vision aspires to:**
* Lead the U.S. market as a benchmark in generic pharmaceutical distribution.
* Advance technology-driven operations that enhance fulfillment speed and traceability.
* Build sustainable business practices that support healthcare accessibility nationwide.
* Foster a partner-first culture rooted in transparency and responsiveness.
* Continue setting new standards of reliability and trust across human and animal health sectors.

## Licensed in All 50 States

With FDA registration and DSCSA 2025 readiness, our 50-state licensing ensures healthcare providers
across the U.S. receive authentic, safe, and timely pharmaceutical supply.

We work with companies and manufacturers worldwide.

## Preguntas
## frecuentes

Estas son algunas de las preguntas que se hacen nuestros usuarios

### ¿Qué es Empresite?

Empresite es un directorio de empresas creado en 2010 por INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) con el fin de
ayudar a los empresarios a encontrar nuevos clientes, mediante la publicación gratuita de los
productos y servicios que ofrecen.

### ¿Qué beneficios puede obtener mi empresa al aparecer en Empresite?

El objeto de Empresite es favorecer y fomentar las relaciones entre empresas, así como facilitar la
búsqueda de nuevos clientes, mediante el desarrollo de una plataforma única en España con
información actualizada de más de 3 millones de empresas. Por ello, Empresite se puede considerar
como un excelente medio de comunicación gratuito para empresas y autónomos.

### ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

La información de Empresite puede provenir de dos fuentes:
1. Información que publica un usuario registrado y que afirma previamente tener relación directa con
   la empresa.
2. Información procedente de la Base de Datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME), que se nutre de múltiples
   fuentes de información, públicas y privadas como el BORME (Boletín Oficial del Registro
   Mercantil), Depósitos de Cuentas Oficiales, BOE (Boletín Oficial del Estado), Boletines Oficiales
   Provinciales y de CC.AA., Prensa nacional y regional, Investigaciones ad hoc y Publicaciones
   Diversas.


Sea cual fuere el origen de la información disponible en el directorio de Empresite, todo contenido
publicado en la Web de Empresite está sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de
Condiciones de uso y Política de privacidad.

### ¿Cómo puedo buscar una empresa en concreto?

Existen varias vías para realizar una búsqueda de una empresa:
1. Rellenando los campos del buscador de la parte superior de la Home de Empresite.
2. Mediante la búsqueda alfabética de empresas o de categorías situada en la parte inferior de la
   Home de Empresite.

### ¿Cómo puedo añadir una empresa?

Añadir una empresa en el directorio de Empresite es un proceso muy sencillo para el que únicamente
se requiere estar registrado como usuario y estar relacionado de manera directa con la empresa a
publicar. Puedes encontrar tu empresa navegando por Empresite, o bien a través del enlace en la
cabecera "Publica tu empresa" donde únicamente necesitarás indicar el CIF. Pincha [aquí][147] y
publica ahora tu empresa.

### ¿Se mantiene algún histórico después de borrar los datos de Empresite?

Tanto el registro en Empresite como el uso y disfrute del servicio, son gratuitos. El usuario
únicamente se verá sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad.

### ¿Por qué no puedo modificar una empresa?

Puede haber varios motivos por el que el sistema no permita modificar una empresa del directorio de
Empresite, los más comunes pueden ser:
1. Que otro usuario tenga registrada la misma empresa.
2. Que el sistema detecte que el usuario no pertenece a esa empresa o no tiene relación directa con
   ella.
3. Que un usuario haya reportado un abuso sobre la empresa y la información de la empresa esté
   siendo investigada.

### ¿Cómo han aparecido los datos de mi empresa en Empresite?

Como se especifica en el apartado anterior, la información publicada en Empresite puede proceder de
los usuarios del directorio o de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME). Más información sobre
las fuentes de Empresite en [¿De dónde viene la información de Empresite?][148]

### Los datos de mi empresa no son correctos o son falsos, ¿qué puedo hacer?

Cualquier usuario que advierta información incorrecta o falsa sobre su empresa, tendrá el deber de
informar al Equipo de Empresite, tal y como se especifica en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad, mediante la opción “Repotar abuso” que está disponible en cada ficha de
empresa. Tras ello, se recibirá respuesta por parte del Equipo de Empresite en un plazo máximo de 2
días hábiles. ¿Los datos de tu empresa no son correctos? Reporta un abuso ahora.

### ¿Alguien puede modificar los datos de mi empresa?

Es requisito por parte de Empresite que únicamente las personas que tengan relación directa con una
empresa puedan publicar datos de ésta.

### No recuerdo mi contraseña, ¿cómo puedo recuperarla?

Se puede recuperar la contraseña rápidamente desde la zona de Acceso usuarios, pinchando en Recordar
contraseña. Automáticamente el Equipo de Empresite enviará las claves a la dirección de correo del
registro.

Los datos de usuario se pueden modificar desde la Zona de Usuarios en a sección de Mi cuenta/ Datos
de usuario. Si quieres modificar tus datos de usuario pincha [aquí][149].

### ¿Cómo borrar mi empresa del directorio de Empresite?

Si has registrado una empresa, puedes borrar la información que has cedido a Empresite mediante el
formulario “reportar abuso”. Tras ello, el Equipo de Empresite eliminará los datos proporcionados
por el usuario. En cualquier caso, los datos provenientes de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A.
