## Preguntas
## frecuentes

Estas son algunas de las preguntas que se hacen nuestros usuarios

### ¿Qué es Empresite?

Empresite es un directorio de empresas creado en 2010 por INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) con el fin de
ayudar a los empresarios a encontrar nuevos clientes, mediante la publicación gratuita de los
productos y servicios que ofrecen.

### ¿Qué beneficios puede obtener mi empresa al aparecer en Empresite?

El objeto de Empresite es favorecer y fomentar las relaciones entre empresas, así como facilitar la
búsqueda de nuevos clientes, mediante el desarrollo de una plataforma única en España con
información actualizada de más de 3 millones de empresas. Por ello, Empresite se puede considerar
como un excelente medio de comunicación gratuito para empresas y autónomos.

### ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

La información de Empresite puede provenir de dos fuentes:
1. Información que publica un usuario registrado y que afirma previamente tener relación directa con
   la empresa.
2. Información procedente de la Base de Datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME), que se nutre de múltiples
   fuentes de información, públicas y privadas como el BORME (Boletín Oficial del Registro
   Mercantil), Depósitos de Cuentas Oficiales, BOE (Boletín Oficial del Estado), Boletines Oficiales
   Provinciales y de CC.AA., Prensa nacional y regional, Investigaciones ad hoc y Publicaciones
   Diversas.


Sea cual fuere el origen de la información disponible en el directorio de Empresite, todo contenido
publicado en la Web de Empresite está sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de
Condiciones de uso y Política de privacidad.

### ¿Cómo puedo buscar una empresa en concreto?

Existen varias vías para realizar una búsqueda de una empresa:
1. Rellenando los campos del buscador de la parte superior de la Home de Empresite.
2. Mediante la búsqueda alfabética de empresas o de categorías situada en la parte inferior de la
   Home de Empresite.

### ¿Cómo puedo añadir una empresa?

Añadir una empresa en el directorio de Empresite es un proceso muy sencillo para el que únicamente
se requiere estar registrado como usuario y estar relacionado de manera directa con la empresa a
publicar. Puedes encontrar tu empresa navegando por Empresite, o bien a través del enlace en la
cabecera "Publica tu empresa" donde únicamente necesitarás indicar el CIF. Pincha [aquí][147] y
publica ahora tu empresa.

### ¿Se mantiene algún histórico después de borrar los datos de Empresite?

Tanto el registro en Empresite como el uso y disfrute del servicio, son gratuitos. El usuario
únicamente se verá sujeto a las condiciones de uso descritas en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad.

### ¿Por qué no puedo modificar una empresa?

Puede haber varios motivos por el que el sistema no permita modificar una empresa del directorio de
Empresite, los más comunes pueden ser:
1. Que otro usuario tenga registrada la misma empresa.
2. Que el sistema detecte que el usuario no pertenece a esa empresa o no tiene relación directa con
   ella.
3. Que un usuario haya reportado un abuso sobre la empresa y la información de la empresa esté
   siendo investigada.

### ¿Cómo han aparecido los datos de mi empresa en Empresite?

Como se especifica en el apartado anterior, la información publicada en Empresite puede proceder de
los usuarios del directorio o de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME). Más información sobre
las fuentes de Empresite en [¿De dónde viene la información de Empresite?][148]

### Los datos de mi empresa no son correctos o son falsos, ¿qué puedo hacer?

Cualquier usuario que advierta información incorrecta o falsa sobre su empresa, tendrá el deber de
informar al Equipo de Empresite, tal y como se especifica en el apartado de Condiciones de uso y
Política de privacidad, mediante la opción “Repotar abuso” que está disponible en cada ficha de
empresa. Tras ello, se recibirá respuesta por parte del Equipo de Empresite en un plazo máximo de 2
días hábiles. ¿Los datos de tu empresa no son correctos? Reporta un abuso ahora.

### ¿Alguien puede modificar los datos de mi empresa?

Es requisito por parte de Empresite que únicamente las personas que tengan relación directa con una
empresa puedan publicar datos de ésta.

### No recuerdo mi contraseña, ¿cómo puedo recuperarla?

Se puede recuperar la contraseña rápidamente desde la zona de Acceso usuarios, pinchando en Recordar
contraseña. Automáticamente el Equipo de Empresite enviará las claves a la dirección de correo del
registro.

### ¿Cómo puedo modificar mis datos de usuario?

Los datos de usuario se pueden modificar desde la Zona de Usuarios en a sección de Mi cuenta/ Datos
de usuario. Si quieres modificar tus datos de usuario pincha [aquí][149].

### ¿Cómo borrar mi empresa del directorio de Empresite?

Si has registrado una empresa, puedes borrar la información que has cedido a Empresite mediante el
formulario “reportar abuso”. Tras ello, el Equipo de Empresite eliminará los datos proporcionados
por el usuario. En cualquier caso, los datos provenientes de la base de datos de INFORMA D&B S.A.
(SME) se mantendrán publicados en el Directorio de Empresite. Más información sobre las fuentes del
Directorio de Empresite en ¿De dónde viene la información sobre empresas de Empresite?

### ¿A disposición de quien está la información que aporto de mi empresa?

Usted accede a poner el contenido a disposición de otras compañías, organizaciones o personas
físicas que accedan a consultar información de su empresa a través de este sitio en Internet
(empresite) o cualquier otro que la empresa INFORMA D&B S.A. (SME) disponga, o como parte de
servicios o productos en cualquier jurisdicción en la que opere INFORMA.

dedicated to the business of identifying sound investment projects. Every issue consists of a new
list of ventures that are meticulously selected by the NPCS team after rigorous screening on
multiple investment factors — ensuring that each project recommendation is grounded in real market

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In

## Expanding the

[slide_innovation]
[slide_patient]
[slide_globally]

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

Innovation Fuels Breakthroughs Breakthroughs Unlock Possibilities Possibilities Enhance Lives

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

and asking the prospective job aspirants to appear for a face-to-face interview for a job opening
with Glenmark and/or to pay a fee for securing a job with Glenmark. We wish to caution the public
that Glenmark does not collect any monies or any other valuables as a pre or post-employment
requirement.

Innovation at Glenmark is driven by a clear purpose: to advance differentiated, science-led
therapies that address health conditions and deliver meaningful benefit to patients. Our innovative
portfolio is concentrated across Respiratory, Dermatology, and Oncology – the therapeutic areas
where medical need is significant, science is evolving rapidly, and Glenmark has built deep clinical
and development expertise. 

Our approach to innovation is defined by therapeutic focus, scientific rigor, and global
partnerships, accelerating access to next-generation therapies. By advancing novel and specialty
therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening
Glenmark’s position as a global, innovation-led pharmaceutical company. 

Accessibility is embedded into how we develop, manufacture, and deliver medicines. Through scalable
manufacturing, fair pricing models, and differentiated delivery formats, we work to make
high-quality therapies across diverse healthcare segments, especially in markets where access
remains limited.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

## GMP+ Feed Certification scheme

The GMP+ Feed Certification (GMP+ FC) scheme provides internationally recognised standards to
produce safe feed, and a growing set of international standards for sustainable feed.

## Our chain approach


The strength of our scheme lies in our unique chain approach. Safe and sustainable feed can only be
achieved when companies work together as a coherence within the feed chain. That's why all companies
from collection to production can be GMP+ certified. Because a chain is as strong as its weakest
link.

[ Collaborations ][61]

[Our chain approach]

## Benefits of GMP+ Certification

### Unique chain approach


GMP+ certified companies do business with companies which are likewise certified. Because all
companies work according to the same standards, we create a uniform chain from collection to
production.  

### HACCP and ISO


The GMP+ FC scheme has integrated HACCP and is based on ISO 22000 standards.

### A growing community


As a GMP+ certified company, you are part of a growing and committed community of over 19,000
companies in 87 countries. GMP+ certified companies enjoy a very solid reputation for being reliable
and committed to feed safety.

### Independent audits


GMP+ certified companies are audited yearly by auditors working for independent Certification
Bodies.

[ Benefits ][62]

## Subscribe to our newsletters


At GMP+ International we believe that sharing knowledge is a prerequisite for a safe and sustainable
feed chain. Please sign up for our newsletters with information about our scheme, training
opportunities, sector developments, feed legislation and more. In this way you are always informed.

# Your Global Bridge to Critical Medicines

As a trusted pharmaceutical supplier since 2003, GNH India bridges the gap between the world's most
critical medicines and the patients and institutions who need them. From named patient supply and
orphan drug sourcing to clinical trial supply and government pharmaceutical programs — we deliver
with regulatory precision, cold chain integrity, and a commitment to access that goes beyond
borders.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

### Specialization

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

FAQ

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
Third, contact details stay private until both parties agree to connect, no spam, no wasted calls.

Is it really free? What's the business model?

Distributors, importers, wholesalers and sales agents use the platform completely free, browse,
build a profile, send introduction requests. Manufacturers can claim their listing and receive
requests for free too. We plan to offer optional paid features for manufacturers who want promoted
placement and advanced reach, but the core marketplace stays free for both sides.

Who can see my contact details and company information?

Your direct contact information, email, phone, address, is never shown publicly. It's only shared
with a specific counterpart after both sides agree to the introduction. Your company profile (name,
location, categories, description) is public and helps the right partners find you.

How quickly can I realistically expect a first connection?

Distributors with a complete profile and a clear target category typically hear back within a few
days of sending their first request. Manufacturers with detailed profiles and active distribution
offers usually receive their first inbound request within 2-4 weeks. Response speed depends on both
sides, we notify immediately by email so nothing sits unseen.

Can I use the platform in my own language?

Yes. The interface is available in 17 languages, use the language switcher on any page. In your
dashboard you can write your profile, offers and product descriptions in your own language and
translate them to English in one click. Catalog content is also shown machine-translated in several
major languages.

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

## India Entry, GTM, M&A and Feasibility, backed by global research.

For global enterprises entering India, and Indian companies expanding across markets and capital.
KAMRIT runs the strategy work alongside the filings. Our sister firm Claight (same directors, same

every recommendation.

operating plan.

2

and regulatory checklist.

3

filings.

[Plan your India entry][53] [Read GTM playbook][54]
Why KAMRIT

## India's most trusted compliance partner.

15+ years of expertise. Senior-partner accountability. 100% online tracking. No hidden charges.

01

### Senior partner accountability

Every engagement is owned end to end by a partner. No layered teams, no chasing analysts.

02

### Fixed-fee transparent pricing

Published prices for every service. No surprise invoices. Monthly retainers for ongoing compliance.

03

### 100% online delivery

Track applications, documents, and due dates in one dashboard. File from anywhere in India.

04

### India-wide and global

Headquartered in Delhi and Noida, serving clients across India, plus USA, UK, Singapore, and UAE
setup.

How it works

## From enquiry to filing in four steps.

### Tell us what you need

Share a quick description of your business and the service you need. A KAMRIT expert reviews it
within one business day.

### Document review

We send you a precise document checklist. Your dedicated expert reviews everything before any portal
submission.

### Online filing

We file with MCA, GSTN, Income Tax, IPO, RBI, or the relevant authority and track every
notification.

### Approval & ongoing support

You receive your certificate, PAN, GSTIN, or registration number with full digital backup. We stay
on for ongoing compliance.

[Start your filing today][55]
Industries we serve

## Industry-specific advisory across India.

From e-commerce and SaaS to manufacturing and exports, KAMRIT supports businesses across every
industry domain.

[E-commerce & D2C][56] [SaaS & Technology][57] [Manufacturing][58] [Retail & Consumer Goods][59]
[Healthcare & Pharma][60] [Real Estate & Construction][61] [Logistics & Supply Chain][62] [Financial
Services][63] [Education & EdTech][64] [Food & Beverage][65] [Exports & Trading][66] [Agriculture &
Agritech][67] [Energy & Renewables][68] [Automotive][69] [Aerospace & Defence][70] [Media &
Entertainment][71] [Consulting & Professional Services][72]
5+ Years of professional service since 2020
12 Practice areas under one accountable team
100+ Indian and global clients served
4 Office locations: Delhi (HQ), Noida, plus partner offices

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.
* **Strategic work without the Big-Four price.** India entry, feasibility studies, GTM strategy,
  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

## Built for businesses that need both filings and strategy

Most businesses in India choose between two kinds of partner. Filing platforms are fast and cheap,
but they will not advise you on a market entry, a transaction, or an audit. Boutique consulting
firms are strong on strategy, but they will not file your GSTR-3B or push your DIR-3 KYC. KAMRIT
does both.

That works because KAMRIT is structured as a financial services LLP with capability across
registration, tax, audit, and corporate compliance, and it operates alongside our sister firm
Claight (same directors, same shareholders) which publishes research, analytics, and procurement
intelligence across nineteen industries. Filings flow into advisory. Advisory flows into filings.
One partner is accountable.

## What that gets you
* **Volume work without the platform cost.** Private Limited Company registration starts at ₹4,899.
  GST returns from ₹699 a month. Trademark filing at ₹4,899. All fixed fee.

  M&A, and transfer pricing engagements led by senior partners.
* **Research at your shoulder.** Claight market intelligence informs our India entry and GTM work,
  used by clients across SaaS, manufacturing, healthcare, and consumer goods.
* **A single calendar across regulators.** ROC, FEMA, RBI, GST, Income Tax, PF, ESI, Shops Act, all
  owned, filed, and reported on monthly.

Frequently asked

## Quick answers from our experts.

What services does KAMRIT offer?

KAMRIT offers the complete India advisory stack. Company registration (Private Limited, LLP, OPC,
Section 8, Producer, Nidhi), GST registration and returns, income tax and TDS, MCA and ROC
compliance, trademark and IP, payroll and labour, audit and assurance, plus India entry, GTM
strategy, M&A advisory, and FEMA / RBI work.

How is KAMRIT different from IndiaFilings or a typical CA firm?

Two ways. First, we run both the filings (like a platform) and the strategic advisory (like a
consulting firm) under one roof, so a Private Limited Company registration can flow into a GTM
strategy and an audited annual return without changing vendors. Second, KAMRIT and our sister firm
Claight share directors and shareholders, which means our India entry, market sizing, and
procurement intelligence work sits on top of the same research feeds Fortune 500 strategy and
procurement teams already use.

How much does company registration cost in India?

KAMRIT registers a Private Limited Company starting at ₹4,899, an LLP starting at ₹3,899, a One
Person Company at ₹3,899, and a Sole Proprietorship at ₹1,899. Pricing is fixed-fee and inclusive of
MCA name approval, MOA and AOA drafting, incorporation, PAN, TAN, and bank account opening
assistance.

How long does GST registration take?

A standard GST registration takes seven to ten working days from document submission, subject to the
GSTN officer's processing time. KAMRIT files within one business day of receiving complete documents
and tracks every notification end to end.

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,

exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

## "Quality is remembered long after the price is forgotten!"

[About Us][10] [Our Services][11]

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## igniting-success

# Integrated supply chain and mobility solutions provider

Our new icon modernizes our visual identity, reflecting the dynamic and innovative spirit of being
driven forward. Inspired by our ‘Igniting Success’ philosophy, the new brand identity reflects our
dedication to accelerating progress for customers and the broader ecosystem, with a promise to
exceed expectations and make a lasting impact. It is a visual story of our values, ambitions and a
purposeful narrative that constantly reminds us of our purpose and drives us towards the impact we
are here to make.

[Read More][198]

SUCCESS

We seamlessly integrate various tech-enabled logistics solutions for complex requirements. Our
‘Customer First’ approach helps us weave the strands of trust, transparency, safety,
customisation and optimisation that ensures efficiency in all our operations. Our reach and
scalability enable our customers to stay ahead of the competition. With these integrated offerings,
we ensure that our customers achieve what they truly deserve – **Success**.

## Solutions That Drive Progress

### Contract Logistics

Our overarching goal is to optimise the journey of all inputs and finished products, ensuring that
the entire supply chain process is efficient, reliable, and customer-centric. We strive to provide a
seamless experience for our customers

### Freight Forwarding’

We offer air and ocean freight forwarding services for imports and exports through a strong network
of global partnerships. Our proficiency in designing a wide range of technology-led freight
solutions in customs and cross-border compliance

### B2B Express

Over the years, we have been transforming the express logistics space through innovation,
problem-solving, and continuous collaboration with our partners and customers, making logistics
faster, safer and more human.

### Last Mile Delivery

Our comprehensive last mile delivery network enables us to deliver our customers’ products to even
the most remote locations, providing a seamless and convenient shopping experience for their
customers.

### Mobility Solutions

We offer comprehensive mobility services for individuals and enterprises across major cities in
India. Our primary focus is on providing safe and cost-effective transportation solutions while
ensuring a delightful experience

## eDeL-EAR

A user-friendly digital platform designed for our customers providing real-time visualization of
their carbon footprint and empowering them to transition towards green logistics.

[ Read More ][203]

## Green Logistics Ecosystem

Evolving from green last-mile cargo deliveries to a comprehensive suite of green logistics
solutions. Today, Edel is our green logistics ecosystem that empowers our customers to mitigate
emissions across their supply chain.

[ Read More ][204]

## Igniting Excellence
## With Technology

We believe that technology will lead and revolutionise logistics. With this belief, we integrate
technology as a part of our holistic supply chain solutions. We also have an incubator program where
we co-create future-ready tech-powered solutions with the Indian start-up ecosystem.

Technology, when applied to logistics, has been shaping and optimising the supply chain process.
With reduced response time, efficient solutions, end-to-end & real-time visibility, efficiency,
flexibility and insights, the businesses are able to make informed decisions and gain complete
control over their supply chains.

the entire supply chain process is efficient, reliable, and customer-centric. We strive to provide a
seamless experience for our customers

We offer air and ocean freight forwarding services for imports and exports through a strong network
of global partnerships. Our proficiency in designing a wide range of technology-led freight
solutions in customs and cross-border compliance

### B2B Express

Over the years, we have been transforming the express logistics space through innovation,
problem-solving, and continuous collaboration with our partners and customers, making logistics
faster, safer and more human.

### Last Mile Delivery

Our comprehensive last mile delivery network enables us to deliver our customers’ products to even
the most remote locations, providing a seamless and convenient shopping experience for their
customers.

### Mobility Solutions

We offer comprehensive mobility services for individuals and enterprises across major cities in
India. Our primary focus is on providing safe and cost-effective transportation solutions while
ensuring a delightful experience

[quality] Quality
Our non-compromising approach to quality ensures that we are constantly endeavoring to achieve and

[affordability] Affordability
Staying true to our founding principles of being a price disruptor, we deliver affordable medication

[accessibility] Accessibility
More than 50% of India’s total population resides in villages, making access to medicines difficult.
Mankind’s pioneering use of supply chains and a company-owned distribution setup bolsters
accessibility.

## The Global Marine Pharmaceuticals Pipeline

The marine pharmaceuticals website has been prepared with the generous help of several researchers
from academia, industry, and government who are currently involved in the global marine
pharmaceuticals pipeline, which involves both preclinical and clinical research on the pharmacology
of marine-derived chemicals.


The content of the website is aimed at researchers in academia, industry, and government with an
interest in the preclinical and clinical pharmacology of marine compounds, as well as those
individuals among the general public who have an interest in the pharmaceutical potential of the
enormous biodiversity of organisms present in the world's oceans. The global marine pharmaceuticals
pipeline website will also hopefully contribute to inspire and attract a new generation of students
interested in pursuing studies in the clinical and preclinical pharmacology of marine natural
products.

## WELCOME TO MARINE LIFESCIENCES

## About Us

## WHO WE ARE

In 2005, we started as a small-scale distribution business. After years of success in the trading
and distribution sectors, and after building a strong network for marketing across India, we
transition into the manufacturing industry in the year 2015.
Marine Lifesciences has been our initial venture. a facility solely dedicated to the production of
external preparations like creams and ointments and soft gelatin capsules.
We have a team of professionals whose mission is to develop products that meet the market
requirement and a dedicated quality team to ensure the right product is delivered in the market.
Therefore our commitment to quality and our service to customers has achieved us a well-known brand
in the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical industry.
[ Know More ][26]
 

## Our Innovations

## SOFT GEL

We are capable of producing 600 million capsules in a single shift every year.
[ Read More ][27]

## EXTERNAL PREPARATION

We can produce more than 48 million tubes per annum  
[ Read More ][28]

## Why Choose Us

Our facility meets all WHO-GMP guidelines and follows cGMP guidelines to ensure quality. Our
PLC-based machines follow the latest safety standards.
Before taking material into commercial production, it goes through specified quality checks as per
our SOP for Raw Material Testing.
 
Each formulation has a specific SOP where process validation and quality checks are carried out in
process.
 
 
A team of skilled professionals conducts constant R & D to provide insight and help improve current
processes, which increases production and quality.
Our quick response team provides regular follow-ups to our clients as well as quick responses to
customer inquiries.

## Our Operations

Marine Lifesciences is a soft-gelatin and external ointment manufacturing unit. Having established
in the year 2015, today Marine Lifesciences is considered one of the quality manufacturers of soft
gel supplements and pain relieving ointments.
Marine Lifesciences is a WHO-GMP certified soft-gelatin and external ointment manufacturing unit
located in Himachal Pradesh, India. Established in 2015, we are considered one of the quality
manufacturers of soft gel supplements and pain relieving ointments. Our facility is highly regulated
and follows all cGMP guidelines. Our manufacturing unit has a yearly capacity of delivering around
240 million capsules and 30 million ointments a year. We also do contract manufacturing for big
Indian MNCs like Lupin, Aristo, Zydus, Healthkart, Trubasics, Apollo, and many more. As part of the
Marine group, we are an emerging player in the Pharmaceutical Industry with operations in Dubai,
Sudan, Myanmar, and Afghanistan, and we are continuously growing.

## About Us

## WHO WE ARE

In 2005, we started as a small-scale distribution business. After years of success in the trading
and distribution sectors, and after building a strong network for marketing across India, we
transition into the manufacturing industry in the year 2015.
Marine Lifesciences has been our initial venture. a facility solely dedicated to the production of
external preparations like creams and ointments and soft gelatin capsules.
We have a team of professionals whose mission is to develop products that meet the market
requirement and a dedicated quality team to ensure the right product is delivered in the market.
Therefore our commitment to quality and our service to customers has achieved us a well-known brand
in the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical industry.
[ Know More ][26]
 

## Our Innovations

## SOFT GEL

We are capable of producing 600 million capsules in a single shift every year.
[ Read More ][27]

## EXTERNAL PREPARATION

We can produce more than 48 million tubes per annum  
[ Read More ][28]

## Why Choose Us

Our facility meets all WHO-GMP guidelines and follows cGMP guidelines to ensure quality. Our
PLC-based machines follow the latest safety standards.
Before taking material into commercial production, it goes through specified quality checks as per
our SOP for Raw Material Testing.
 
Each formulation has a specific SOP where process validation and quality checks are carried out in
process.
 
 
A team of skilled professionals conducts constant R & D to provide insight and help improve current
processes, which increases production and quality.
Our quick response team provides regular follow-ups to our clients as well as quick responses to
customer inquiries.

## Our Operations

Marine Lifesciences is a soft-gelatin and external ointment manufacturing unit. Having established
in the year 2015, today Marine Lifesciences is considered one of the quality manufacturers of soft
gel supplements and pain relieving ointments.
Marine Lifesciences is a WHO-GMP certified soft-gelatin and external ointment manufacturing unit
located in Himachal Pradesh, India. Established in 2015, we are considered one of the quality
manufacturers of soft gel supplements and pain relieving ointments. Our facility is highly regulated
and follows all cGMP guidelines. Our manufacturing unit has a yearly capacity of delivering around
240 million capsules and 30 million ointments a year. We also do contract manufacturing for big
Indian MNCs like Lupin, Aristo, Zydus, Healthkart, Trubasics, Apollo, and many more. As part of the
Marine group, we are an emerging player in the Pharmaceutical Industry with operations in Dubai,
Sudan, Myanmar, and Afghanistan, and we are continuously growing.

# One partner. Every phase.

Experience. Our Precision.
Watch

What does precision mean to you?

## To us, it is delivering with uncompromising quality, accuracy, speed, and control.

From manufacturing to medicine, origin to arrival, we support pharmaceutical and biotech companies
at every stage, advancing therapies through our controlled environments and validated processes,
with regulatory oversight and guidance.

[About us ][59]

## [End-to-End Solutions][60]

## [Who we are][61]

Read more

## [Global Network][62]

## [Learning Center][63]

## Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics.

With combined experience across healthcare, aviation, and complex secure logistics, we drive the
success of our clients through innovation and precision.

At UPS Healthcare, we have taken our best and made it better. As a leading healthcare logistics
company, we’ve invested in the latest technology and expanded our global footprint, allowing us to
be more responsive and agile than ever, ensuring every patient gets the critical support they need,
when they need it, where they need it.

MNX has officially joined Marken under one global brand: Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics.
Formerly MNX, the brand brings decades of expertise in radiopharmaceuticals, aviation, and complex
secure logistics. While the MNX name is retiring, commitment to serving clients and supporting
patients remains stronger than ever.

Polar Speed is part of Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics: Polar Speed brings forth our
in-network pharmacies and strengthens our patient driven services portfolio.

# Welcome to Marks Marine Pharmacy

Welcome to Marks Marine PharmacyWelcome to Marks Marine PharmacyWelcome to Marks Marine Pharmacy

## About Us

#### A brick and mortar community pharmacy

Marks Marine Pharmacy is a brick-and-mortar store inside a medical clinic, also serving the local
community in Vancouver, British Columbia. Experience peace of mind knowing your medication ships
directly from our fully regulated Canadian Pharmacy, dispensed by a licensed Canadian pharmacist.

#### Meet our pharmacy manager

Robert Rosenblatt - licensed Canadian Pharmacist, graduated from the University of British Columbia.
Rob experienced a massive influx of walk-in American customers driving from Washington and Oregon,
specifically to pick up prescription medication from Marks Pharmacy on Cambie. Therefore, Rob set up
a division of Marks as close as possible to the Vancouver international airport (10 minutes away)
for the sole purpose of benefiting shipping logistics and turnaround time.



Marks has been a well-known Pharmacy chain on the west coast of Canada since the 1950s by Pharmacist
Gordan Marks (RPH 1948 UBC, R.I.P) and then Pharmacist Marvin Nider (RPH UBC 1973, R.I.P). Then Rob
set up a Canada Post station inside the Pharmacy and scheduled the last possible postal pickup.



With 30 years of experience, Rob understands the industry very well.

Now 73, still fully licensed, Rob is happy, in phenomenal shape from a lifetime of proper health and
fitness, practicing what he preaches for complete health and Wellness. Rob retired at 70, passing it
off to second-generation Jordan after working closely together for 20 years, effectively passing the
torch to the next generation.

#### We also ship anywhere within Canada

Experience the ease of use by shipping your medication right to your door.

## Contact Us

#### Better yet, see us in person!

We love our customers, so feel free to visit during normal business hours.

Welcome to Marks Marine PharmacyWelcome to Marks Marine PharmacyWelcome to Marks Marine Pharmacy

## About Us

#### A brick and mortar community pharmacy

Marks Marine Pharmacy is a brick-and-mortar store inside a medical clinic, also serving the local
community in Vancouver, British Columbia. Experience peace of mind knowing your medication ships
directly from our fully regulated Canadian Pharmacy, dispensed by a licensed Canadian pharmacist.

#### Meet our pharmacy manager

Robert Rosenblatt - licensed Canadian Pharmacist, graduated from the University of British Columbia.
Rob experienced a massive influx of walk-in American customers driving from Washington and Oregon,
specifically to pick up prescription medication from Marks Pharmacy on Cambie. Therefore, Rob set up
a division of Marks as close as possible to the Vancouver international airport (10 minutes away)
for the sole purpose of benefiting shipping logistics and turnaround time.



Marks has been a well-known Pharmacy chain on the west coast of Canada since the 1950s by Pharmacist
Gordan Marks (RPH 1948 UBC, R.I.P) and then Pharmacist Marvin Nider (RPH UBC 1973, R.I.P). Then Rob
set up a Canada Post station inside the Pharmacy and scheduled the last possible postal pickup.



With 30 years of experience, Rob understands the industry very well.

Now 73, still fully licensed, Rob is happy, in phenomenal shape from a lifetime of proper health and
fitness, practicing what he preaches for complete health and Wellness. Rob retired at 70, passing it
off to second-generation Jordan after working closely together for 20 years, effectively passing the
torch to the next generation.

#### We also ship anywhere within Canada

Experience the ease of use by shipping your medication right to your door.

## Contact Us

We love our customers, so feel free to visit during normal business hours.

**Privacy Policy**
**1. General provisions**
1.1 This Personal data processing policy is compiled in accordance with the requirements of the Law
of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V "On Personal Data and their Protection" dated May 21, 2013
and defines the procedure for processing personal data and measures to ensure the security of
personal data of Kazakh Pharmaceutical Company "MEDSERVICE PLUS" LLP (herein – Operator).
1.2 The Operator sets the observance of the rights and freedoms of man and citizen as its most
important goal and condition for the implementation of its activities in the processing of personal
data, including the protection of the rights to privacy, personal and family secrets.
1.3 This Policy regarding the processing of personal data of Operator (herein – Policy) applies to
all information that the Operator can receive about website visitors medservice.kz

**2. Basic concepts used in the Policy**
2.1 Automated processing of personal data – processing of personal data using computer technology;
2.2 Blocking of personal data – temporary termination of processing of personal data (except for
cases when processing is necessary for clarification of personal data);
2.3 Website is a set of graphic and information materials, as well as computer programs and
databases, ensuring their availability on the Internet at the network address medservice.kz;
2.4 Information system of personal data is a set of personal data stored in databases and providing
their processing of information technology and technical means;
2.5 Depersonalization of personal data is actions, as a result of which it is impossible to
determine the belonging of personal data to a specific User or other subject of personal data
without the use of additional information;
2.6 Processing of personal data is any action (operation) or set of actions (operations) with
personal data performed using automation tools or without using such means including collection,
recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, clarification (update, change), extraction, use,
transfer (distribution, provision, access), depersonalization, blocking, deletion, destruction of
personal data;
2.7 Operator is a state body, municipal body, legal or natural person, independently or jointly with
other persons organizing and (or) carrying out the personal data processing, as well as defining the
purposes of processing personal data, the composition of personal data subject to processing,
actions (operations) performed with personal data;
2.8 Personal data are any information related directly or indirectly to a specific or determined
User of medservice.kz website;
2.9 User is any visitor of the medservice.kz website;
2.10 Provision of personal data are actions aimed at disclosing personal data to a certain person or
a certain circle of persons;
2.11 Distribution of personal data are any actions aimed at disclosing personal data to an
indefinite circle of persons (transfer of personal data) or familiarization with personal data of an
unlimited circle of persons, including disclosure of personal data in the media, placement in
information and telecommunication networks or providing access to personal data in any other way;
2.12. Cross-border transfer of personal data is transfer of personal data to the territory of a
foreign state to a foreign state authority, a foreign individual or a foreign legal entity;
2.13 Destruction of personal data is any actions as a result of which personal data are permanently
destroyed with the impossibility of further restoration of the content of personal data in the
personal data information system and (or) as a result of which personal data material carriers are
destroyed.


**3. The Operator can process the following personal data of the User**
- Surname, first name;
- Email address;
- Phone number;
- The site also collects and processes depersonalized data about visitors (including cookies) using
Internet statistics services.
The above-listed data, hereinafter referred to in the text of the Policy by the general concept as
Personal Data.


**4. Personal data processing purposes of**
4.1 The purpose of processing the User's personal data is to inform the User by sending emails.
4.2 The Operator also has the right to send notices to the User about new products and services,
special offers and various events. The User can always refuse to receive informational messages by
sending an email to the Operator at info@medservice.kz email address marked "Refusal of notices
about new products and services and special offers".
4.3 Depersonalized User data collected using Internet statistics services are used to collect
information about User actions on the website, improve the quality of the website and its content.


**5. Legal grounds for processing personal data**
5.1 The Operator processes the User's personal data only if they are filled in and/or sent by the
User independently through special forms located on medservice.kz website. By filling in the
appropriate forms and/or sending the personal data to the Operator, the User agrees with this
Policy.
5.2 The Operator processes depersonalized data about the User if this is allowed in the User's
browser settings (the saving of cookies and the use of JavaScript technology are enabled).


**6. The procedure for collecting, storing, transferring and other types of personal data
processing**
6.1 The safety of personal data processed by the Operator is ensured by implementing legal,
organizational and technical measures necessary to fully comply with the requirements of current
legislation in the field of personal data protection.
6.2 The Operator ensures the safety of personal data and takes all possible measures to prevent
unauthorized persons to access the personal data.
The User's personal data will never, under any circumstances, be transferred to third parties,
except in cases related to the implementation of current legislation.
6.3 In case of inaccuracies in personal data, the User can update them independently by sending a
notice to the Operator to the following email address info@medservice.kz marked "Personal data
update".
6.4 The period of processing the personal data is unlimited. The User can withdraw his/her consent
for the processing of personal data at any time by sending a notice to the Operator via e-mail to
the Operator's info@medservice.kzemail address marked "Withdrawal of consent for the processing of
personal data".


**7. Cross-border transfer of personal data**
7.1 Before initiating the cross-border transfer of personal data, the Operator is obliged to make
sure that the foreign state to whose territory the transfer of personal data is supposed to be
carried out provides reliable protection of the rights of personal data subjects.
7.2 Cross-border transfer of personal data to the territory of foreign states that do not meet the
above-specified requirements may be carried out only if there is a written consent of the personal
data subject for the cross-border transfer of his/her personal data and/or execution of the
agreement to which the personal data subject is a party.


**8. Final provisions**
8.1 The User can receive any clarifications on issues of interest concerning the processing of
his/her personal data by contacting the Operator via [info@medservice.kz ][89]e-mail.

**Privacy Policy**
**1. General provisions**
1.1 This Personal data processing policy is compiled in accordance with the requirements of the Law
of the Republic of Kazakhstan No. 94-V "On Personal Data and their Protection" dated May 21, 2013
and defines the procedure for processing personal data and measures to ensure the security of
personal data of Kazakh Pharmaceutical Company "MEDSERVICE PLUS" LLP (herein – Operator).
1.2 The Operator sets the observance of the rights and freedoms of man and citizen as its most
important goal and condition for the implementation of its activities in the processing of personal
data, including the protection of the rights to privacy, personal and family secrets.
1.3 This Policy regarding the processing of personal data of Operator (herein – Policy) applies to
all information that the Operator can receive about website visitors medservice.kz

**2. Basic concepts used in the Policy**
2.1 Automated processing of personal data – processing of personal data using computer technology;
2.2 Blocking of personal data – temporary termination of processing of personal data (except for
cases when processing is necessary for clarification of personal data);
2.3 Website is a set of graphic and information materials, as well as computer programs and
databases, ensuring their availability on the Internet at the network address medservice.kz;
2.4 Information system of personal data is a set of personal data stored in databases and providing
their processing of information technology and technical means;
2.5 Depersonalization of personal data is actions, as a result of which it is impossible to
determine the belonging of personal data to a specific User or other subject of personal data
without the use of additional information;
2.6 Processing of personal data is any action (operation) or set of actions (operations) with
personal data performed using automation tools or without using such means including collection,
recording, systematization, accumulation, storage, clarification (update, change), extraction, use,
transfer (distribution, provision, access), depersonalization, blocking, deletion, destruction of
personal data;
2.7 Operator is a state body, municipal body, legal or natural person, independently or jointly with
other persons organizing and (or) carrying out the personal data processing, as well as defining the
purposes of processing personal data, the composition of personal data subject to processing,
actions (operations) performed with personal data;
2.8 Personal data are any information related directly or indirectly to a specific or determined
User of medservice.kz website;
2.9 User is any visitor of the medservice.kz website;
2.10 Provision of personal data are actions aimed at disclosing personal data to a certain person or
a certain circle of persons;
2.11 Distribution of personal data are any actions aimed at disclosing personal data to an
indefinite circle of persons (transfer of personal data) or familiarization with personal data of an
unlimited circle of persons, including disclosure of personal data in the media, placement in
information and telecommunication networks or providing access to personal data in any other way;
2.12. Cross-border transfer of personal data is transfer of personal data to the territory of a
foreign state to a foreign state authority, a foreign individual or a foreign legal entity;
2.13 Destruction of personal data is any actions as a result of which personal data are permanently
destroyed with the impossibility of further restoration of the content of personal data in the
personal data information system and (or) as a result of which personal data material carriers are
destroyed.


**3. The Operator can process the following personal data of the User**
- Surname, first name;
- Email address;
- Phone number;
- The site also collects and processes depersonalized data about visitors (including cookies) using
Internet statistics services.
The above-listed data, hereinafter referred to in the text of the Policy by the general concept as
Personal Data.


**4. Personal data processing purposes of**
4.1 The purpose of processing the User's personal data is to inform the User by sending emails.
4.2 The Operator also has the right to send notices to the User about new products and services,
special offers and various events. The User can always refuse to receive informational messages by
sending an email to the Operator at info@medservice.kz email address marked "Refusal of notices
about new products and services and special offers".
4.3 Depersonalized User data collected using Internet statistics services are used to collect
information about User actions on the website, improve the quality of the website and its content.


**5. Legal grounds for processing personal data**
5.1 The Operator processes the User's personal data only if they are filled in and/or sent by the
User independently through special forms located on medservice.kz website. By filling in the
appropriate forms and/or sending the personal data to the Operator, the User agrees with this
Policy.
5.2 The Operator processes depersonalized data about the User if this is allowed in the User's
browser settings (the saving of cookies and the use of JavaScript technology are enabled).


**6. The procedure for collecting, storing, transferring and other types of personal data
processing**
6.1 The safety of personal data processed by the Operator is ensured by implementing legal,
organizational and technical measures necessary to fully comply with the requirements of current
legislation in the field of personal data protection.
6.2 The Operator ensures the safety of personal data and takes all possible measures to prevent
unauthorized persons to access the personal data.
The User's personal data will never, under any circumstances, be transferred to third parties,
except in cases related to the implementation of current legislation.
6.3 In case of inaccuracies in personal data, the User can update them independently by sending a
notice to the Operator to the following email address info@medservice.kz marked "Personal data
update".
6.4 The period of processing the personal data is unlimited. The User can withdraw his/her consent
for the processing of personal data at any time by sending a notice to the Operator via e-mail to
the Operator's info@medservice.kzemail address marked "Withdrawal of consent for the processing of
personal data".


**7. Cross-border transfer of personal data**
7.1 Before initiating the cross-border transfer of personal data, the Operator is obliged to make
sure that the foreign state to whose territory the transfer of personal data is supposed to be
carried out provides reliable protection of the rights of personal data subjects.
7.2 Cross-border transfer of personal data to the territory of foreign states that do not meet the
above-specified requirements may be carried out only if there is a written consent of the personal
data subject for the cross-border transfer of his/her personal data and/or execution of the
agreement to which the personal data subject is a party.

# CRM para captar y convertir más clientes

## Construimos sistemas que generan clientes: captación, CRM y ventas

Unimos captación, CRM y automatización en la generación de leads para tu empresa. Gestión con orden
y cierre de más ventas sin perder leads por el camino.

[ Agenda una reunión con nosotros ][243]

## ¿Se te escapan Leads sin saber por qué?

Muchas empresas tienen actividad comercial, pero no control sobre ella. Llegan contactos, se hacen
llamadas, se mandan presupuestos… y luego no hay forma de saber qué pasó con cada uno.3 síntomas
(cards o lista visual):

***«Tengo leads, pero no sé cuántos acaban en venta»***
Los contactos entran por varios canales y nadie los sigue de forma sistemática.

***«Marketing y ventas van por separado»***
Se genera tráfico y campañas, pero nadie conecta ese esfuerzo con los cierres reales.

***«Hacemos demasiadas cosas a mano»***
Excel, WhatsApp, correos sueltos. Información que vive en la cabeza de cada persona, no en un
sistema.

Si alguno de estos tres puntos te suena, el problema no es tu equipo ni tus herramientas. Es que aún
no tienes un sistema que lo conecte todo.

[icono-capta-leads]

### Capta leads cualificados

Posicionamos tu empresa para que te encuentren las personas que ya están buscando lo que ofreces.
SEO orientado a intención de compra, no a visitas genéricas.

[icono-ordena-crm]

### Ordénalos con tu CRM

Implantamos y configuramos Zoho CRM adaptado a tu proceso de ventas real. Cada lead tiene
seguimiento, cada oportunidad tiene estado, nada se pierde.

[icono-convierte-clientes]

### Conviértelos en clientes

Automatizamos las tareas repetitivas, conectamos marketing con ventas y medimos qué acciones generan
clientes de verdad. El sistema trabaja aunque tu equipo esté ocupado.

No instalamos software y nos vamos. Diseñamos el proceso completo: desde que alguien te encuentra en
Google hasta que se convierte en cliente.

El resultado no es tener tres herramientas. Es tener un proceso que funciona de principio a fin.

## Partners Tecnológicos

[GC-Partner-no_outline-H]

## ¿Cómo ayudamos a Pymes y Autónomos?

Ayudamos a empresas a captar mejor y convertir mejor conectando CRM, lead generation e IA.

En Millennials Consulting ayudamos a pymes y autónomos a vender con más orden y menos improvisación.
Diseñamos sistemas que permiten captar leads, organizarlos correctamente y hacer un seguimiento más
claro hasta la venta. Combinamos CRM, automatización, estrategia digital e IA aplicada para que el
negocio gane tiempo, control y capacidad de crecimiento.
