# CRM para captar y convertir más clientes

## Construimos sistemas que generan clientes: captación, CRM y ventas

Unimos captación, CRM y automatización en la generación de leads para tu empresa. Gestión con orden
y cierre de más ventas sin perder leads por el camino.

[ Agenda una reunión con nosotros ][243]

## ¿Se te escapan Leads sin saber por qué?

Muchas empresas tienen actividad comercial, pero no control sobre ella. Llegan contactos, se hacen
llamadas, se mandan presupuestos… y luego no hay forma de saber qué pasó con cada uno.3 síntomas
(cards o lista visual):

***«Tengo leads, pero no sé cuántos acaban en venta»***
Los contactos entran por varios canales y nadie los sigue de forma sistemática.

***«Marketing y ventas van por separado»***
Se genera tráfico y campañas, pero nadie conecta ese esfuerzo con los cierres reales.

***«Hacemos demasiadas cosas a mano»***
Excel, WhatsApp, correos sueltos. Información que vive en la cabeza de cada persona, no en un
sistema.

Si alguno de estos tres puntos te suena, el problema no es tu equipo ni tus herramientas. Es que aún
no tienes un sistema que lo conecte todo.

[icono-capta-leads]

### Capta leads cualificados

Posicionamos tu empresa para que te encuentren las personas que ya están buscando lo que ofreces.
SEO orientado a intención de compra, no a visitas genéricas.

[icono-ordena-crm]

### Ordénalos con tu CRM

Implantamos y configuramos Zoho CRM adaptado a tu proceso de ventas real. Cada lead tiene
seguimiento, cada oportunidad tiene estado, nada se pierde.

[icono-convierte-clientes]

### Conviértelos en clientes

Automatizamos las tareas repetitivas, conectamos marketing con ventas y medimos qué acciones generan
clientes de verdad. El sistema trabaja aunque tu equipo esté ocupado.

No instalamos software y nos vamos. Diseñamos el proceso completo: desde que alguien te encuentra en
Google hasta que se convierte en cliente.

El resultado no es tener tres herramientas. Es tener un proceso que funciona de principio a fin.

## Other Healthcare Providers

[Hospitals][146] - Find all Hospitals including Acute General Hospitals, Psychiatric Hospital, Long
Term Care Hospitals, Rehabilitation Hospitals, Pediatric Hospitals, and Chronic Disease Hospitals.

[Urgent Care Centers][147] - Urgent care centers primarily treat injuries or illnesses requiring
immediate care, but not serious enough to require an ER visit. Most Urgent Care Centers remain open
7 days a week from 9:00am to 7:00pm. Find urgent care clinics in USA.

[Pharmacies and Drugstores][148] - Find all pharmacies and drugstores in USA including Retail and
Community Pharmacies, mail order pharmacies as well as speciality drugstores.

[Podiatrists (Foot Doctor)][149] - Podiatrists diagnose and treat foot diseases and deformities.
They perform medical, surgical and other operative procedures, prescribe corrective devices and
prescribe and administer drugs and physical therapy. Podiatrists are also referred as foot doctors
and/or chiropodist.

[Chiropractors][150] - Chiropractic medicine is the discipline within the healing arts which deals
with the nervous system and its relationship to the spinal column and its interrelationship with
other body systems.

[Physical Therapists][151] - Physical therapists are health care professionals who evaluate and
treat people with health problems resulting from injury or disease.

[Occupational Therapists][152] - Occupational therapy services are provided for the purpose of
promoting health and wellness and are provided to those who have or are at risk for developing an
illness, injury, disease, disorder, condition, impairment, disability, activity limitation, or
participation restriction.

[Psychologists][153] - A psychologist is an individual who is licensed to practice psychology which
is defined as the observation, description, evaluation, interpretation, and modification of human
behavior by the application of psychological principles, methods, and procedures, for the purpose of
preventing or eliminating symptomatic, maladaptive, or undesired behavior and of enhancing
interpersonal relationships, work and life adjustment, personal effectiveness, behavioral health,
and mental health.

[Counselors][154] - Counselors are health service providers who are trained and educated in the
performance of behavior health services through interpersonal communications and analysis.

[Clinical Social Workers][155] - A social worker who holds a master's or doctoral degree in social
work from an accredited school of social work in addition to at least two years of post-master's
supervised experience in a clinical setting. The social worker must be licensed, certified, or
registered at the clinical level in the jurisdiction of practice.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

## Frequently asked questions

What does Optimus do?
Optimus is a leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), delivering
comprehensive, end-to-end solutions from clinical development to commercial manufacturing of Key
Starting Materials(KSMs), Regulatory Starting Materials(RSMs), Advanced Intermediates, Drug
Substances and Drug Products to the global innovative biotech and pharmaceutical companies.
In which areas does Optimus specialise?

Optimus specialises in:
* Exclusive development and manufacturing of Late phase Molecules.
* Custom Manufacturing of KSM’s, RSMs and Advanced Intermediates.
* Backward integration of KSM’s / Intermediates
* Development and Manufacturing of Oral Solids / Semi Solids dosage forms

How does Optimus ensure quality and compliance?
Quality is maintained through stringent standards in R&D and manufacturing, supported by strong
regulatory understanding, IP management, and robust process development, validation, and
tech-transfer capabilities.
What is the scale of manufacturing capacity?
Optimus provides flexible manufacturing capacity from gram-scale to multi-tonne production,
supporting efficient and cost-effective scale-up of complex molecules and niche molecules.
Does Optimus support custom API or formulation development?
Yes. With a team of 150+ scientists and advanced facilities, Optimus offers custom process
development, analytical method validation, tech transfer, and commercial scale-up for both drug
substances and drug products.
What are the advantages of partnering with Optimus?
* 20+ years of industry expertise
* Integrated backward manufacturing offering cost advantage
* High-quality R&D for complex and niche molecules
* Global export capability and regulatory readiness
* Focus on innovation, affordability, and excellence
Can Optimus support technology transfer or process validation?
Yes. Our expertise team has extensive experience in both technology transfer from a third party
manufacturing site as well as process validations under strict quality and regulatory frameworks.
How does Optimus handle regulatory compliance and documentation?
All submissions are supported with complete documentation such as ANDA / DMFs / IMPD , technical
packages, validation reports, and CMC data to facilitate multi-market regulatory filings.
Does Optimus offer finished formulations or only APIs?
Optimus offers both drug substance and drug products developed through its dedicated formulation R&D
and manufacturing units.

## Unsere Branchen

### Konsumgüter

Logistik-Fulfillment für den B2B- und B2C-Konsumgütermarkt gehört zu den Kernkompetenzen der
pfenning-Gruppe. Egal ob Elektrogeräte, Textilien, Kosmetikartikel, Möbel oder viele andere
Konsumgüter – bei uns sind Ihre Artikel in sicheren Händen.

[Mehr erfahren][157]

### Lebensmittel

Temperierte HACCP-Lagerung und IFS-zertifizierte Auslieferung von Lebens­mitteln sind Teil unserer
Unternehmens-DNA. Qualität und Frische bilden zusammen mit dem Spezial-Equipment seit mehr als 3
Jahrzenten das Herz­stück unserer Kühl­expertise.

[Mehr erfahren][158]

[retail icon]

### Handel

Die Wiedervermarktung von Retouren ist für Händler ein entscheidender Wettbewerbsvorteil. Mit
unserem Retourenmanagement erhalten Non-Food-Artikel eine zweite Absatzchance und sorgen für den
entscheidenden Unterschied beim Gewinn.

[Mehr erfahren][159]

[pharma icon]

### Pharma

Die Pharma Logistik bedingt verlässliche Leistungen ohne Risiken und Nebenwirkungen – dafür fragen
Sie am besten uns. Neben GDP-konformen Lagerflächen – temperiert und auslaufsicher –  bieten wir
eine sichere Kühl­kette und effektive Lager­prozesse.

[Mehr erfahren][160]

[automotive icon]

### Automotive & Industrie

Spezialisierte Logistiklösungen bei der Produktionsversorgung, Lagerbevorratung,
(SKD-)Teilesequenzierung oder in der Werkslogistik: mit der pfenning-Gruppe konzentrieren sich
Automotive- und Industrieunternehmen mit voller Kraft auf ihr Kerngeschäft.

[Mehr erfahren][161]

[chemie icon]

### Chemie

Umweltgefährdende, ätzende oder giftige Gefahrstoffe müssen eingelagert werden? Das macht eine
Viel­zahl an spezifischen Vorkehrungen und Genehmigungen notwendig. Ob Logistik-Neubau,
In­betrieb­nahme oder komplettes Out­sourcing – wir sind Ihr Partner.

[Mehr erfahren][162]

Branchenvielfalt ist seit 125 Jahren die Basis unseres Erfolgs. Ganz gleich, welcher Branche Ihr
Unternehmen angehört – die pfenning-Gruppe konzipiert eine individuelle Logistiklösung.

[Jetzt kontaktieren][163]
[Mitarbeiter icon]

### 7.000 Mitarbeitende

Jede Familie lebt von ihrer Vielfalt – so auch die pfenning-Familie. Deshalb beschäftigen wir
unterschiedliche Talente. Vom Lagermitarbeitenden bis zur Führungskraft.

[standort icon]

### 110 Standorte

Betriebsstandorte der pfenning-Gruppe haben Platz für Vieles: sie dienen der Produktion, der
Warenaufbereitung, den individuellen Mehrwertleistungen, die wir für unsere Kunden erbringen.

[LKW Grafik]

### 1.000 LKW

Für die differenzierten Anforderungen unserer Branchen stellen wir das ideale Fuhrpark-Equipment zur
Verfügung: zeitgemäß, flexibel und leistungsstark.

[stern icon]

### Top Handelslogistiker

Mit einem flächendeckenden Lager- und Distributionsnetz und Spezialfahrzeugen gehört die
pfenning-Gruppe zu den führenden Handelslogistikern in Deutschland.

[Grafik Unternehmen]

### 1.000.000 m² Lagerfläche

Rund um die Uhr, an sieben Tagen in der Woche. Auf insgesamt 1.000.000 m² Logistikfläche finden
Unternehmen Platz für Güter aller Art.

## Logistik in der 3. Generation

Was Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts mit regionalen Milch-Transporten begann, ist heute eine national
erfolgreiche Unternehmens­gruppe, die in dritter Generation vom Inhaber geführt wird. Im Jahre 2013
hat das Unternehmen am Firmen­sitz Heddesheim, im Herzen der Metropol­region Rhein-Neckar, ein
europaweit einzigartiges Logistik­zentrum errichtet, das mit seinen viel­fältigen
Nutzungs­möglichkeiten auf einer Fläche von 50 Hektar neue Dimensionen eröffnet. Im selben Jahr
erhält der „multicube rhein-neckar“ von der Deutschen Gesellschaft für nachhaltiges Bauen das
DGNB-Gold-Zertifikat mit einer Best­note von 1,21 aller neu gebauten Industrie­anlagen Europas und ist
somit die Nummer 1 aller Neubau-Industrie­anlagen in Europa. Diese Erfolgs­geschichte führen wir mit
dem multicube rhein­hessen nun weiter, im Juli 2020 erhält der multicube rheinhessen mit einem
Gesamt­erfüllungs­grad von 83,5% die Auszeichnung DGNB Platin, und gehört somit zu den Top 10 in
Europa.

Mit unseren 7.000 Mitarbeiter:innen an 110 Standorten erzielen wir immer neue Erfolgs­ergebnisse, die
nur in einem eingespielten Team gelingen können. Dabei bestimmen ein paar simple Leit­begriffe unser
tägliches Handeln:  Aufrichtigkeit, Verlässlichkeit, Fairness und Respekt.

[Mehr erfahren][159]

[pharma icon]

### Pharma

Die Pharma Logistik bedingt verlässliche Leistungen ohne Risiken und Nebenwirkungen – dafür fragen
Sie am besten uns. Neben GDP-konformen Lagerflächen – temperiert und auslaufsicher –  bieten wir
eine sichere Kühl­kette und effektive Lager­prozesse.

[Mehr erfahren][160]

[automotive icon]

### Automotive & Industrie

Spezialisierte Logistiklösungen bei der Produktionsversorgung, Lagerbevorratung,
(SKD-)Teilesequenzierung oder in der Werkslogistik: mit der pfenning-Gruppe konzentrieren sich
Automotive- und Industrieunternehmen mit voller Kraft auf ihr Kerngeschäft.

[Mehr erfahren][161]

[chemie icon]

### Chemie

Umweltgefährdende, ätzende oder giftige Gefahrstoffe müssen eingelagert werden? Das macht eine
Viel­zahl an spezifischen Vorkehrungen und Genehmigungen notwendig. Ob Logistik-Neubau,
In­betrieb­nahme oder komplettes Out­sourcing – wir sind Ihr Partner.

[Mehr erfahren][162]

Branchenvielfalt ist seit 125 Jahren die Basis unseres Erfolgs. Ganz gleich, welcher Branche Ihr
Unternehmen angehört – die pfenning-Gruppe konzipiert eine individuelle Logistiklösung.

[Jetzt kontaktieren][163]
[Mitarbeiter icon]

### 7.000 Mitarbeitende

Jede Familie lebt von ihrer Vielfalt – so auch die pfenning-Familie. Deshalb beschäftigen wir
unterschiedliche Talente. Vom Lagermitarbeitenden bis zur Führungskraft.

[standort icon]

### 110 Standorte

Betriebsstandorte der pfenning-Gruppe haben Platz für Vieles: sie dienen der Produktion, der
Warenaufbereitung, den individuellen Mehrwertleistungen, die wir für unsere Kunden erbringen.

[LKW Grafik]

### 1.000 LKW

Für die differenzierten Anforderungen unserer Branchen stellen wir das ideale Fuhrpark-Equipment zur
Verfügung: zeitgemäß, flexibel und leistungsstark.

[stern icon]

### Top Handelslogistiker

Mit einem flächendeckenden Lager- und Distributionsnetz und Spezialfahrzeugen gehört die
pfenning-Gruppe zu den führenden Handelslogistikern in Deutschland.

[Grafik Unternehmen]

### 1.000.000 m² Lagerfläche

Rund um die Uhr, an sieben Tagen in der Woche. Auf insgesamt 1.000.000 m² Logistikfläche finden
Unternehmen Platz für Güter aller Art.

## Logistik in der 3. Generation

Was Ende des 19. Jahrhunderts mit regionalen Milch-Transporten begann, ist heute eine national
erfolgreiche Unternehmens­gruppe, die in dritter Generation vom Inhaber geführt wird. Im Jahre 2013
hat das Unternehmen am Firmen­sitz Heddesheim, im Herzen der Metropol­region Rhein-Neckar, ein
europaweit einzigartiges Logistik­zentrum errichtet, das mit seinen viel­fältigen
Nutzungs­möglichkeiten auf einer Fläche von 50 Hektar neue Dimensionen eröffnet. Im selben Jahr
erhält der „multicube rhein-neckar“ von der Deutschen Gesellschaft für nachhaltiges Bauen das
DGNB-Gold-Zertifikat mit einer Best­note von 1,21 aller neu gebauten Industrie­anlagen Europas und ist
somit die Nummer 1 aller Neubau-Industrie­anlagen in Europa. Diese Erfolgs­geschichte führen wir mit
dem multicube rhein­hessen nun weiter, im Juli 2020 erhält der multicube rheinhessen mit einem
Gesamt­erfüllungs­grad von 83,5% die Auszeichnung DGNB Platin, und gehört somit zu den Top 10 in
Europa.

Mit unseren 7.000 Mitarbeiter:innen an 110 Standorten erzielen wir immer neue Erfolgs­ergebnisse, die
nur in einem eingespielten Team gelingen können. Dabei bestimmen ein paar simple Leit­begriffe unser
tägliches Handeln:  Aufrichtigkeit, Verlässlichkeit, Fairness und Respekt.

[Jetzt entdecken][164]

individuals with qualifications such as **B Pharm, M Pharm, D Pharm, Pharm D, MSC, BSC, PHD,

In the industry, there are numerous fake job portals that do not provide genuine vacancies. Here, we
ensure that we first confirm with HR before uploading any job listings for you.

pharmaceutical and biotech industries. Our job categories include:

**[Warehouse][153]:** Find positions related to pharmaceutical warehouse management.

industries.

sector.

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

### About Conference



**Conference Series!!** Cordially invites participants from all over the world to
attend **“[4^{th} World Congress on Pharmaceutics, Formulations & Novel Drug Delivery
Systems][77]”** with a theme of  **“*Futuristic Scope of Next Generation Drug Delivery on Pharma
Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

**Conference Benefits:**

•   Live Sessions
•   Certification of Recognition
•   Meet your Academic idols
•   Hear about latest research
•   Engage in High level debates & Q/A
•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value
•   Networking Sessions

**Target Audience**
* Pharma Research Community

* Directors of Organizations

* Drug Delivery Entities
* Medical Groups
* Related Associations
* Biomedical Device Industries
* Medical Device Industries

 

### Sessions and Tracks


**Track 1: [Pharmaceutics][82]**

[Pharmaceutics][83] are one of the primary factors for developing a [drug][84] as it involves in
converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

**Track 2: ****[Pharmaceutical Science and Research Advancements][85]**

[Pharmaceutical research][86] is the process through which potential new medicines are identified.
It involves a wide range of scientific disciplines, including biology, chemistry and pharmacology.
Research Drug development is the process of bringing a new pharmaceutical drug into the market once
a lead compound has been identified through the process of drug discovery. Research and development
used in developing the new series or products or improvement of existing products and services. 
* [Pharmacoepidemiology][87]
* Pharmaceutical Cell Biology
* Pharmaceutical regulatory sciences
* Recent trends in pharma technology
* Prevalance of Potential drugs

**Track 3:** **[Process Validation][88]**

[Process validation][89] is defined as the collection and evaluation of data, from
the process design stage throughout production, which establishes scientific evidence that
a process is capable of consistently delivering quality products.
* [Prospective Validation][90] This type of validation is performed before production, during a
  product's development stage
* Concurrent Validation
* Retrospective Validation
* Revalidation

**Track 4: [Drug Discovery and Development][91]**

A drug goes from being an idea in the lab to something that a doctor prescribes. To do this, it must
go through a long development and approval process. During this process, researchers make sure the
drug is safe for people to take and effectively treats cancer. This process often takes many years
and significant resources. But the actual amount of time and money needed depends on the drug.

There are 3 main steps in finding and developing a new drug:
* [Preclinical research][92], which is when the drug is found and first tested
* [Clinical research][93], which is when the drug is tested in people
* [Post-clinical research][94], which takes place after the drug is approved

**Track 5: [Novel Developments in Drug Delivery System][95]**
* Controlled Drug Delivery System
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipments

[Novel Drug delivery System][96] can be referred as, approaches, formulations, technologies, and
systems for transporting a pharmaceutical compound in the body as needed to safely achieve its
desired therapeutic effects.

In current research, Drug delivery systems has described in four broad categories:
* Routes of delivery,
* Delivery vehicles,
* Cargo
* Targeting strategies.

Drug delivery can be in a variety of ways by:
* Swallowing
* Inhalation
* Absorption through the skin
* Intravenous injection.

Drug delivery systems can be:
* [Controlled Drug Delivery System][97]
* Ocular Drug Delivery System
* 2D & 3D Printing in Drug Delivery
* Drug Delivery: Devices And Equipment’s

**Track 6: [Pharmaceutical Formulation][98]**

[Pharmaceutical formulation][99], in pharmaceutics, is the process in which different chemical
substances, including the active the drug, are combined to produce a final medicinal product. The
word formulation is often used in a way that includes dosage form.

**Track 7: [Pharmacology & Toxicology][100]**

[Pharmacology][101] is a branch of medicine or pharmaceutical sciences. It mainly deals with the
study of the body's reaction to drugs.

Interactions that occur between a living organism and chemicals that affect a normal or abnormal
biochemical function. Any substances that possess medicinal properties are considered to be
pharmaceuticals.

Sub-divisions of Pharmacology mainly include:
* Pharmacotherapeutics
* [Toxicology][102]
* Experimental pharmacology
* Clinical Pharmacology
* Chemotherapy

Toxicology studies the negative consequences of pharmaceuticals and chemical substances as well as
treatment options, while pharmacology studies the positive effects of drugs.

**Track 8: [Formulation Design and Pharmaceutical Technology][103]**

All pharmaceutical products are formulated to specific dosage forms for drugs to be effectively
delivered to patients. Typical pharmaceutical dosage forms include oral tablets, capsules,
solutions, suspensions, topical ointments, gels, and solutions, and injections for intravenous (IV),
intramuscular (IM), or subcutaneous (SC) administration. In addition, various drug delivery systems
have been developed for transdermal, intranasal, and pulmonary deliveries. Different dosage forms
require different [pharmaceutical technologies][104] and usually present different technical
challenges for formulation development.

Because of the complex technical challenges scientists encounter during formulation development, it
is important to use an effective methodology. Design of experiments and statistical analysis have
been applied widely to formulation development, and are useful in process optimization and process
validation. The major advantage of using Design of experiments to develop formulations
for [pharmaceutical products][105] is that it allows all potential factors to be evaluated
simultaneously, systematically, and quickly.

# 1949

The Gjendemsjø family has been innovative for generations. It all started in 1949 when Lauritz
decided to be a fisherman instead of taking over his family farm. Since then, he was a fisherman by

late 60's, Lauritz wanted to take things to a new level and increase the value of the fish they

As a young child Leif Kjetil wanted to help his father and at the age of 8 he started his career
cutting cod tongues in his father`s fish processing-factory and selling them as delicacy to
relatives and neighbors. He learned early that we should only harvest what we need and utilize
everything we harvest from nature. This has become a mantra that he have brought with him ever
since.

# 1982

Growing up, Leif Kjetil used to help out at the factory after school, and as his father he also fell

one of the first factories in the world to produce omega-3 concentrates.

# 2007

well together. They are probably the most experienced team in the industry.

# 2008

# 2008

It was very important for Pharma Marine™ that the new product would be from sustainable raw
materials and we wanted to bring something new to the omega-3 market. The idea about omega-3 oil
from squid was born in 2007, and in 2009 the first batch with CalaMarine® was produced. This product
became the first omega-3 concentrates in the world made from trimmings of food production of squid.

# 2011

# 2011

In 2011 Pharma Marine™ saw the need of being able to offer customers the more classic type of fish
oil from anchovies, sardines and mackerel and launched the ingredient line LipidMarine™. This is a
line with a wide range of high quality EPA and DHA oils with a great sensory profile.

# 2014

# 2014

Leif Kjetil had for a long time had a dream about using the trimmings, not only the liver, from
Norwegian fishing boats to produce omega-3 oils. Being from a fisher family he knew very well that
the fishermen were looking for ways to utilize the trimmings of food production of wild-caught fish.
When the knowledgeable and innovative Norwegian fisheries invested in production of fish oil and
fish meal onboard the fishing vessels – they became the perfect supplier and partner for Pharma
Marine. As a result of this, CodMarine® was launched in 2014. Because of this collaboration with the
local fisheries the CodMarine® – products has a tracing system, making it possible for the consumer
to trace their oil back to the fishing vessel and the area the fish was caught.

# 2016

# 2016

After a lot of thinking and experimenting about how we could help consumers increase their omega-3
intake, GourmetMarine™ was developed in 2016. Knowing that not all consumers want to take liquid oil
on a spoon or soft gels, we wanted to find a way to help more people get omega-3 in their diet. By
formulating premium quality omega-3 oil with healthy vegetable oils we are able to provide consumers
with a delicious oil they can use on their food. With GourmetMarine™ we hope to inspire more people
to get omega-3 in to their diet. We continue to develop our technologies and methods to be sure we
always supply our customers with an oil with superior sensory profile that is optimized for both our
products and the consumers. In the end of 2016 we installed a specially developed liquid bottling
line so we can offer our customers finished product with unique formulations bottled at our facility
in Norway.

# 2018

# 2018

We installed a new machine in 2018 for filling oil in sachets. This new delivery form will make it
more convenient for the consumers to get their daily dosage in a single package, and for them to
bring fresh oil on travels or just out for lunch. It is also the perfect delivery form for Pharma
Marine`s customers to use for sampling.

# 2020

# 2020

Pharma Marine always work to provide premium products that makes it convenient for everyone to get
their daily dosage of the important omega-3 fatty acids (EPA and DHA), that is why we launched a
plant based product in 2020. VegMarine™ is a product line with superior sensory profile oils
produced from sustainable micro algae in closed and sterile systems.

# 2024

# 2024

We are proud of Pharma Marine being a family business with family values at its core. We believe in
close relationships with our partners, our employees, and our local community. And, of course, an
enduring respect for nature. Outside our doorstep on Terøy, there is a vast sea of possibilities.
For our planet, our health, and future generations.

## Innovatieve oplossingen op maat

Wij creëren een gemeenschappelijke functionaliteit tussen alle elektrische en
automatiseringssystemen aan boord van uw schepen. We zijn trots op onze innovatieve oplossingen, die
niet alleen technisch ongeëvenaard zijn, maar ook op maat gemaakt om te voldoen aan de unieke eisen
van uw activiteiten. 

Met onze ervaring in de integratie van elektrische maritieme systemen en technische expertise
garanderen dat uw schepen varen volgens de hoogste normen van efficiëntie, veiligheid en
betrouwbaarheid. 

Met passie en vakmanschap maximaliseren wij uw maritieme prestaties.

[Rhodium Family logo]
[Rhodium Bridge en automation]
[Rhodium Power en Cyber Systems]

Ontdek onze Rhodium Suite met geavanceerde hardware, software en diensten voor veilige navigatie,
efficiënte energieopwekking en scheepsautomatisering. Ontworpen voor marineschepen en jachten,
verlegt Rhodium technologische grenzen met geïntegreerde oplossingen die waarde toevoegen aan elk
schip.

[Bekijk onze Rhodium Suite][52]

[Collega's in overleg]

### Gecombineerde kennis en toegepaste innovatie

Over de hele wereld ontwikkelen kennisinstellingen, universiteiten en fabrikanten nieuwe elektrische
en automatiseringscomponenten met ongekende mogelijkheden. Als systeemintegrator brengt RH Marine
deze componenten samen om nieuwe en verbeterde functionaliteiten mogelijk te maken voor
scheepswerven en eindgebruikers.

Door intensieve samenwerking met industriële partners helpen we scheepsbouwers en operators om
voorop te blijven lopen met geavanceerde technologieën en toekomstbestendige systemen. 

Onze expertise in maritieme automatisering stelt ons in staat innovatieve oplossingen te bieden die
voldoen aan de hoogste eisen.

[Collega's in overleg]
[Refit2 1]

### Volledige support tijdens gehele lifecycle

RH Marine biedt uitgebreide ondersteuning gedurende de hele levenscyclus van uw schip. Of het nu
gaat om periodiek onderhoud, modificaties of upgrades, onze Service Engineers staan altijd paraat. 

Met een uitgebreide installed base in diverse maritieme sectoren heeft RH Marine een sterke
reputatie opgebouwd sinds haar oprichting. Onze end-to-end benadering waarborgt dat uw schepen
continu optimaal inzetbaar blijven en uitstekend presteren wanneer dat nodig is. 

Al sinds 1860 garanderen we veilige, duurzame, comfortabele en kostenefficiënte scheepsoperaties
door de integratie van slimme en zorgvuldig ontworpen oplossingen.

Om een oplossing zo optimaal mogelijk te implementeren, is expertise nodig. Wij leveren op allerlei
gebieden deze expertise, of het nu om systeemintegratie of inbedrijfstelling gaat, of een vraagstuk
is in het verlengde van onze producten en systemen, zoals service en onderhoud of spare parts.

## Werken bij RH Marine

Onze collega's zijn de basis van de organisatie en ze zijn trots op wat ze doen, loyaal en betrokken
bij het bedrijf. Veel collega’s werken al 15 jaar of langer bij RH Marine en het personeelsverloop
is laag. En dat heeft een reden. De verscheidenheid aan projecten, technische uitdagingen,
doorgroeimogelijkheden en goede sfeer zorgen ervoor dat je met plezier naar je werk gaat.

Niets geeft meer voldoening dan de eerste vaart van een schip waarvoor wij de elektrische en
automatiseringssystemen hebben geleverd. Vanaf het eerste programma van eisen tot aan de
uiteindelijke installatie weten wij hoeveel denkwerk, planning, coördinatie en samenwerking daarbij
komt kijken. Een hele prestatie waar we allemaal trots op zijn!

## Innovatieve oplossingen op maat

Wij creëren een gemeenschappelijke functionaliteit tussen alle elektrische en
automatiseringssystemen aan boord van uw schepen. We zijn trots op onze innovatieve oplossingen, die
niet alleen technisch ongeëvenaard zijn, maar ook op maat gemaakt om te voldoen aan de unieke eisen
van uw activiteiten. 

Met onze ervaring in de integratie van elektrische maritieme systemen en technische expertise
garanderen dat uw schepen varen volgens de hoogste normen van efficiëntie, veiligheid en
betrouwbaarheid. 

Met passie en vakmanschap maximaliseren wij uw maritieme prestaties.

[Rhodium Family logo]
[Rhodium Bridge en automation]
[Rhodium Power en Cyber Systems]

Ontdek onze Rhodium Suite met geavanceerde hardware, software en diensten voor veilige navigatie,
efficiënte energieopwekking en scheepsautomatisering. Ontworpen voor marineschepen en jachten,
verlegt Rhodium technologische grenzen met geïntegreerde oplossingen die waarde toevoegen aan elk
schip.

[Bekijk onze Rhodium Suite][52]

[Collega's in overleg]

### Gecombineerde kennis en toegepaste innovatie

Over de hele wereld ontwikkelen kennisinstellingen, universiteiten en fabrikanten nieuwe elektrische
en automatiseringscomponenten met ongekende mogelijkheden. Als systeemintegrator brengt RH Marine
deze componenten samen om nieuwe en verbeterde functionaliteiten mogelijk te maken voor
scheepswerven en eindgebruikers.

Door intensieve samenwerking met industriële partners helpen we scheepsbouwers en operators om
voorop te blijven lopen met geavanceerde technologieën en toekomstbestendige systemen. 

Onze expertise in maritieme automatisering stelt ons in staat innovatieve oplossingen te bieden die
voldoen aan de hoogste eisen.

[Collega's in overleg]
[Refit2 1]

### Volledige support tijdens gehele lifecycle

RH Marine biedt uitgebreide ondersteuning gedurende de hele levenscyclus van uw schip. Of het nu
gaat om periodiek onderhoud, modificaties of upgrades, onze Service Engineers staan altijd paraat. 

Met een uitgebreide installed base in diverse maritieme sectoren heeft RH Marine een sterke
reputatie opgebouwd sinds haar oprichting. Onze end-to-end benadering waarborgt dat uw schepen
continu optimaal inzetbaar blijven en uitstekend presteren wanneer dat nodig is. 

Al sinds 1860 garanderen we veilige, duurzame, comfortabele en kostenefficiënte scheepsoperaties
door de integratie van slimme en zorgvuldig ontworpen oplossingen.

 

## Ontdek onze diensten & services

Om een oplossing zo optimaal mogelijk te implementeren, is expertise nodig. Wij leveren op allerlei
gebieden deze expertise, of het nu om systeemintegratie of inbedrijfstelling gaat, of een vraagstuk
is in het verlengde van onze producten en systemen, zoals service en onderhoud of spare parts.

## Werken bij RH Marine

Onze collega's zijn de basis van de organisatie en ze zijn trots op wat ze doen, loyaal en betrokken
bij het bedrijf. Veel collega’s werken al 15 jaar of langer bij RH Marine en het personeelsverloop
is laag. En dat heeft een reden. De verscheidenheid aan projecten, technische uitdagingen,
doorgroeimogelijkheden en goede sfeer zorgen ervoor dat je met plezier naar je werk gaat.

Niets geeft meer voldoening dan de eerste vaart van een schip waarvoor wij de elektrische en
automatiseringssystemen hebben geleverd. Vanaf het eerste programma van eisen tot aan de
uiteindelijke installatie weten wij hoeveel denkwerk, planning, coördinatie en samenwerking daarbij
komt kijken. Een hele prestatie waar we allemaal trots op zijn!

Als **Erfinder der Blow-Fill-Seal (BFS) Technologie** ist Rommelag Ihr zuverlässiger
One-Stop-Partner für aseptische Verpackungs­lösungen für Ihre flüssigen Produkte. Neben unseren
leistungs­starken bottelpack Abfüllanlagen bieten wir Lohnabfüll­dienst­leistungen, Unterstützung bei
der Produkt­entwicklung sowie ein umfassendes Service­angebot für alle Ihre Verpackungs­anforderungen.

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Ganz gleich, ob Sie die BFS-Technologie ohne großes Investitionsrisiko testen möchten,
Produktionsspitzen abdecken oder Marktchargen vollständig produzieren wollen – unsere
**[Lohnabfüllung][44] **bietet Ihnen modernste Anlagen und ein umfassendes Servicepaket zu äußerst
wettbewerbsfähigen Preisen.

Zudem bietet unser erfahrenes Team umfassende Unterstützung bei der **Entwicklung **und Optimierung
Ihres Produkts für die Blow-Fill-Seal-Technologie.

The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,

convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment

22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

Astellas Pharma is facing a defining moment as its blockbuster prostate cancer therapy, Xtandi
(enzalutamide), approaches a massive patent cliff in 2026 and 2027. With billions in annual revenue
at risk, the pharmaceutical giant is pivoting toward aggressive lifecycle management and strategic
BD (Business Development) to offset the impending generic competition. For generic manufacturers and
oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly
deconstruct original patent claims and identify "late-stage" IP vulnerabilities is the key to

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Boat Supplies & Boating Accessories in Australia

Are you a boat owner who has been wondering “where can I find a [marine shop near me][28] that can
supply everything I need?” The Marine Centre is the boating warehouse boat owners throughout the
country turn to for all the marine supplies they need, and we can help you too.

As one of the leading boating stores in the country, we stock a huge range of the very best boat
supplies and boating accessories Australia wide. We can supply customers all over the country with
all kinds of electronic, anchoring, seating, plumbing, cleaning, maintenance, safety and other
boating and fishing related products, available for purchase online or from our warehouse in
Derrimut, Melbourne.

## Quality Marine Supplies You Can Depend On

The Marine Centre stocks a vast range of quality boating supplies, including [marine supplies for
anchoring][29], docking, plumbing and much more. No matter what supplies you need for your boat, you
can rest assured that our products are constructed from quality materials and made to last.

Our complete range of marine supplies includes:
* Anchoring and docking
* Cabin, deck and hull
* Electronics
* Plumbing and pumps
* Seating products
* Refrigeration and food storage
* Cleaning and maintenance
* Safety items
* Sporting equipment
* Trailer parts and accessories

## The Best Range of Stainless Steel Boat Accessories in Australia

If you’re looking for the best range of stainless steel [boat accessories in Australia][30], look no
further. The Marine Centre offers an impressive selection of stainless steel boat accessories
online, with everything from anchors and cup holders through to rod holders, steering wheels and
outriggers. Our stainless steel accessories offer unparalleled durability and corrosion resistance,
making them an ideal choice for withstanding saltwater and other harsh marine conditions.

## Why Shop with Us?

The Marine Centre has earned a reputation as one of the best boat shops in the business thanks to
our team of boating experts. Every staff member at our boat shop has extensive knowledge when it
comes to [boat supplies][31] and boat accessories in Australia for all kinds of vessels. Whether you
own a sailboat, yacht, powerboat or any other type of vessel, we can help you get what you need to
make your time on the water more enjoyable.

The Marine Centre is also the boating warehouse to turn to if your vessel requires any repair,
servicing or maintenance work. Our first-class boat aftercare centre is staffed by a team of boating
technicians who can carry out professional repair, service or maintenance work for all kinds of new
and used fibreglass vessels, with an extended warranty offered on all our work. [BOOK FREE
CONSULTATION][32] today!

##

# Boat Supplies & Boating Accessories in Australia

Are you a boat owner who has been wondering “where can I find a [marine shop near me][28] that can
supply everything I need?” The Marine Centre is the boating warehouse boat owners throughout the
country turn to for all the marine supplies they need, and we can help you too.

As one of the leading boating stores in the country, we stock a huge range of the very best boat
supplies and boating accessories Australia wide. We can supply customers all over the country with
all kinds of electronic, anchoring, seating, plumbing, cleaning, maintenance, safety and other
boating and fishing related products, available for purchase online or from our warehouse in
Derrimut, Melbourne.

## Quality Marine Supplies You Can Depend On

The Marine Centre stocks a vast range of quality boating supplies, including [marine supplies for
anchoring][29], docking, plumbing and much more. No matter what supplies you need for your boat, you
can rest assured that our products are constructed from quality materials and made to last.

Our complete range of marine supplies includes:
* Anchoring and docking
* Cabin, deck and hull
* Electronics
* Plumbing and pumps
* Seating products
* Refrigeration and food storage
* Cleaning and maintenance
* Safety items
* Sporting equipment
* Trailer parts and accessories

## The Best Range of Stainless Steel Boat Accessories in Australia

If you’re looking for the best range of stainless steel [boat accessories in Australia][30], look no
further. The Marine Centre offers an impressive selection of stainless steel boat accessories
online, with everything from anchors and cup holders through to rod holders, steering wheels and
outriggers. Our stainless steel accessories offer unparalleled durability and corrosion resistance,
making them an ideal choice for withstanding saltwater and other harsh marine conditions.

## Why Shop with Us?

The Marine Centre has earned a reputation as one of the best boat shops in the business thanks to
our team of boating experts. Every staff member at our boat shop has extensive knowledge when it
comes to [boat supplies][31] and boat accessories in Australia for all kinds of vessels. Whether you
own a sailboat, yacht, powerboat or any other type of vessel, we can help you get what you need to
make your time on the water more enjoyable.

The Marine Centre is also the boating warehouse to turn to if your vessel requires any repair,
servicing or maintenance work. Our first-class boat aftercare centre is staffed by a team of boating
technicians who can carry out professional repair, service or maintenance work for all kinds of new
and used fibreglass vessels, with an extended warranty offered on all our work. [BOOK FREE
CONSULTATION][32] today!

## Contact Us Today

Next time you’re asking yourself “where’s the best [marine shop][33] near me?”, make The Marine
Centre your first choice. Call us today on [(03) 9394 1530][34] or [contact us online][35] to learn
more about our affordable boat supplies and boating accessories Australia wide.

experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.

deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

[woman holding capsule]
* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.
* 2015
  
  We streamlined the capsule manufacturing filling process with the launch of Ultra III®, a
  high-speed, semi-automatic filling machine, providing drug developers with an innovative and
  flexible solution to meet a wide array of filling requirements.
* 2016
  
  The first customer commercialized our proprietary lipid multi-particulate technology,
  strengthening our positioning as an industry-leading partner in the nutraceutical and
  pharmaceutical markets.
* 2017
  
  We purchased Capsugel and InterHealth to create a leading integrated solutions provider to the
  global pharma and consumer healthcare industries.
* 2019
  
  In response to changing regulations and consumer demand for an alternative solution, we created
  the Vcaps® Plus White Opal® capsule. This is a titanium dioxide-free, white colored capsule that
  is suitable for vegan and vegetarian diets, as well as being allergen and gluten-free.
* 2020
  
  The Lonza Engine® Alliance Program was launched. This is our partnership with some of the world’s
  leading equipment manufacturers, where we offer reliable powder-filling equipment, plus
  world-class service and support capabilities.

## mission

#### UNDP works in 170 countries and territories to eradicate poverty while protecting the planet.
#### We help countries develop strong policies, skills, partnerships and institutions so they can
#### sustain their progress.

## What we do

UNDP is the United Nations’ lead agency on international development. We support countries and
communities as they work to eradicate poverty, implement the Paris Agreement on climate change and
achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. We advocate for transformative change, and we connect
countries to the resources they need to help people build a better life.

[Learn more][25]

[Construction worker in a neon safety vest and knit cap grips a lifting hook under blue
scaffolding.]

### Human development on a healthy planet

UNDP works with countries to expand people’s choices for a future where prosperity and
sustainability advance together, leaving no one behind. Through integrated, evidence-driven action
aligned with national priorities, UNDP works to accelerate human development while easing pressures
on the planet.

[Photograph of four smiling children posing among rocky ruins under a bright blue sky.]

### Prosperity for all

UNDP focusses on creating prosperity for all, while maintaining our strong footprint in poverty and
inequality programming. This shift aligns with our partners' changing aspirations: moving beyond the
goalpost of a minimum poverty line to build dynamic, resilient economies and societies where
everyone can thrive.

[Person in a light blue shirt holds a card with a circular logo outdoors; crowd and trees in back.]

### Effective governance

UNDP develops accountable, people-centred and rights-based governance. Using systems thinking,
innovation and strategic foresight, UNDP helps countries develop more agile, anticipatory governance
and policymaking and provide responsive services and economic opportunities, including increased
access to services through digitalization and AI.

[Two construction workers on a dirt site with chalk markings; one points, rock piles behind.]

sustainability advance together, leaving no one behind. Through integrated, evidence-driven action

### Crisis resilience

From day one of a crisis, UNDP focuses on protecting development gains and reducing risk, laying the
groundwork for recovery and eventual exit from reliance on humanitarian assistance. UNDP acts as a
“bridge-builder” between the humanitarian, development and peacebuilding systems, helping to
maintain continuity across response phases and advance long-term development.

[Person in a cornfield holds a round woven basket of yellow corn.]

### Healthy planet

UNDP is a leading connector at the nexus of planet and development, delivering integrated solutions
on climate change, disasters, biodiversity loss, energy, chemicals and waste, while advancing
development priorities. Translating global commitments into effective local action, we support
countries to assess their options for achieving just and sustainable transitions.

[Photograph of hands holding a smartphone displaying a colorful app interface.]

### Digital and AI transformation

UNDP’s broad expertise and country-driven approach allow us to support holistic digital
transformation in an integrated, systemic way. UNDP has worked with over 120 countries to leverage
digitalization, including helping institutions and people develop the capabilities to access and use
technology and data; and supporting countries to implement robust digital public infrastructure.

[Three costumed performers on a wooden porch, center in a white headdress, brown-gold outfits.]

### Gender equality

Complementing the work of UN Women, UNDP designs its interventions for a deliberate impact on gender
equality, seen by partners as one of its most effective areas of work. Through its trusted
relationships with governments, UNDP is well placed to help advance women’s empowerment across all
dimensions of development.

[Market fruit stand with a shirtless vendor serving fruit to a customer, surrounded by melons.]

### Sustainable finance

UNDP works to accelerate development and expand investment opportunities in emerging and developing
economies. We help countries mobilize domestic resources and strengthen their institutional
frameworks, making financial governance more stable and transparent. We work with development
finance institutions and the private sector to scale financing instruments such as blended finance,
green bonds and insurance.

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]

# A legacy of 70 years in bringing innovative pharmaceutical solutions to life

[About us][13]
[Innovation Excellence]

## Driven by a passion for innovation, making a difference in the world of health and care

[Innovation Excellence][14]
[Zydus Srishti]

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

[View More][24]
